title: Infra Tech Support Practitioner
description:
**Project Role :** Infra Tech Support Practitioner  

**Project Role Description :** Provide L1–L2 technical support for infrastructure, systems, and applications in production and development environments, both remotely and onsite, following defined operating models and processes. Act as the primary interface with users/clients to accurately diagnose issues and deliver effective resolutions across infrastructure, operating systems, networks, and application platforms, ensuring service stability and quality support.
  

**Must have skills :** Network Operations \& Service Management  

**Good to have skills :** SD Access Operations  

Minimum **5** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

As an Infra Tech Support Practitioner, a typical day involves delivering first and second level technical assistance for infrastructure, systems, and applications across both production and development settings. This role requires working closely with users and clients, either remotely or onsite, to identify and resolve issues efficiently. The practitioner follows established operational procedures to maintain service stability and quality, ensuring smooth functioning of various technology platforms. Collaboration with different teams and adherence to defined processes are key aspects of daily activities, contributing to a reliable and responsive support environment.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:
  

Lead LAN/WLAN current\-state assessment and discovery.  

Develop and validate LAN/WLAN HLD/LLD.  

Design and implement Aruba Switching solutions.  

Design and implement Aruba Wireless solutions.  

Work with Aruba Central for configuration, monitoring and management.  

Support campus LAN/WLAN modernization and technology refresh.  

Develop site migration and cutover strategies.  

Validate switch, wireless and network configurations.  

Support deployment waves and site migrations.  

Troubleshoot complex LAN/WLAN issues.  

Coordinate with Prisma SD\-WAN, NAC/security and infrastructure teams.  

Support post\-migration validation and stabilization.  

Define deployment standards and configuration templates.  

Mandatory Skills  

Aruba Switching – Mandatory  

Aruba Wireless – Mandatory  

Aruba Central – Mandatory  

Enterprise LAN/WLAN  

Routing \& Switching  

Wireless design and troubleshooting  

Network migration  

Network deployment  

  

Professional \& Technical Skills:
  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Network Operations \& Service Management.
* Good To Have Skills: Experience with SD Access Operations.
* Strong knowledge of network infrastructure components and service management frameworks.
* Ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex issues related to network operations and service delivery.
* Familiarity with monitoring tools and incident management systems to ensure timely response and resolution.
* Experience in coordinating with multiple teams to maintain operational efficiency and service quality.


  

Additional Information:
  

* The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Network Operations \& Service Management.
* This position is based at our Bengaluru office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

  

15 years full time education

title: Storage Technical Support
description:
**Company Description** 




**About Sutherland**




 Artificial Intelligence. Automation. Cloud engineering. Advanced analytics. For business leaders, these are key factors of success. For us, they’re our core expertise.
 



 We work with iconic brands worldwide. We bring them a unique value proposition through market\-leading technology and business process excellence.
 



 We’ve created over 200 unique inventions under several patents across AI and other critical technologies. Leveraging our advanced products and platforms, we drive digital transformation, optimize critical business operations, reinvent experiences, and pioneer new solutions, all provided through a seamless “as a service” model.
 



 For each company, we provide new keys for their businesses, the people they work with, and the customers they serve. We tailor proven and rapid formulas, to fit their unique DNA. We bring together human expertise and artificial intelligence to develop digital chemistry. This unlocks new possibilities, transformative outcomes and enduring relationships.
 



 Sutherland
 *Unlocking digital performance. Delivering measurable results.* 




  





**Job Description** 




**Technical Support Engineer** 




*Enterprise Storage Platforms* 




  





**Shift** 
 – 24/7
 



  





**Work Location** 
 – Bangalore, Brookfield office. Cab will be provided to the candidates within 25KM range only.
 



  





**Work Model:** 
 Work from Office
 



  





**Experience** 
 : 2\-7 years
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a Technical Support Engineer to join our enterprise storage support team in a high\-touch, mission\-critical environment. This role is a great fit for someone with solid hands\-on experience in enterprise storage and infrastructure troubleshooting who genuinely enjoys solving complex customer problems.
 



 You will work on real\-world issues across storage platforms and associated infrastructure, supporting customers through phone, email, chat, and remote sessions. You'll be expected to own cases end to end, communicate clearly under pressure, and bring structured thinking to every troubleshooting scenario.
 



**What You'll Do** 



* Provide technical support to enterprise customers on complex storage and infrastructure issues across a global 24x7 model.
* Own cases end to end, from initial triage through troubleshooting, communication, documentation, and resolution.
* Diagnose problems spanning storage protocols, host connectivity, controller behaviour, performance symptoms, platform interoperability, and more.
* Troubleshoot any HW and SW issues that comes up during ongoing platform use.
* Manage customer communication with professionalism and urgency, especially during business\-impacting situations.
* Work closely with cross\-functional teams including escalation teams, engineering, and customer stakeholders to drive timely outcomes.
* Maintain high\-quality case notes, action plans, and technical documentation throughout the support lifecycle.
* Adhere to SLA targets, escalation protocols, and quality standards consistently.



**Required Experience** 



* 3–6 years of relevant experience in technical support, infrastructure support, and enterprise storage support.
* Solid track record in customer\-facing troubleshooting roles within enterprise IT environments.
* Demonstrated hands\-on understanding of enterprise storage concepts and troubleshooting methodology.



**Technical Skills** 



* **Storage:** 
 Strong working knowledge of SAN and NAS environments (protocols \- FC, iSCSI, NFS, and CIFS/SMB), including RAID, high availability, controller architecture, disk behaviour, and failover concepts.
* **OS:** 
 Good working knowledge of Linux and Windows administration fundamentals.
* **Virtualization:** 
 Familiarity with VMware or similar virtualization platforms and their integration with storage.
* **Networking:** 
 Good grounding in TCP/IP, DNS, routing, switching, and connectivity troubleshooting.
* **Diagnostics:** 
 Ability to analyze logs, alerts, symptoms, and customer\-reported behaviour to isolate the root cause or likely fault domain.



**Preferred Skills** 



* Experience supporting enterprise storage platforms such as NetApp ONTAP, FAS / AFF controllers, StorageGRID, E\-Series, or equivalent (Dell EMC, HPE, Pure, IBM, Hitachi).
* Prior experience in managed service or enterprise support environments handling platform or infrastructure incidents.
* Familiarity with critical case management, and ITSM tools (ServiceNow, Salesforce, or equivalent).



**How You Work** 



* You communicate clearly, written and verbal and can hold your own during high\-pressure customer conversations.
* You set expectations well and follow through, even when resolution timelines are uncertain.
* You stay composed during escalations and apply structured thinking rather than guesswork.
* You take ownership seriously and don't pass problems without context.
* You work well with distributed, cross\-functional teams across time zones.

Working knowledge of ITIL concepts such as incident management, request fulfillment, escalation management, and knowledge management.

Minimum qualification: Technical diploma or graduate degree. Minimum 4\-6 years of experience in IT Help Desk, Service Desk, Desktop Support, or technical support operations. Experience in a 24x7 support model is preferred.

Excellent verbal and written English communication skills. Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical users. Strong listening, probing, and questioning skills to identify root cause quickly. Ability to provide constructive feedback, coaching, and guidance to analysts. Strong customer service orientation with patience, empathy, ownership, and a positive attitude. Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills. ****Deliverable****
****Level 1 \- Associate****
****Field Services Technician I****
* Respond to IT service tickets using documented procedures and supervision
* Assist with workstation setups and peripheral connections
* Perform basic AV checks and room readiness tasks
* Support imaging and deployments under direction
* Maintain accurate ticket documentation in ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow)
* Follow proper inventory handling, tagging, and tracking
* Escalate unresolved issues appropriately
* Adhere to safety protocols and client\-specific guidelines


****Field Services Technician II(Lead Single Man Sites)****
* Independently manage onsite IT support at single\-person or lead\-assigned locations
* Serve as the primary contact for end\-user technical needs
* Own AV/conference room setup, maintenance, and issue resolution
* Execute full lifecycle support: imaging, deployment, recovery, e\-waste
* Oversee inventory reconciliation and tool usage
* Prioritize and resolve tickets aligned to SLA targets
* Identify recurring issues and suggest process improvements
* Provide informal mentorship and support to visiting or junior technicians
* Uphold Astreya’s quality and service standards through professional communication and client interaction


**Essential Duties And Responsibilities (All Levels)**
**End\-User Support**
* Provide onsite and remote technical support for end users, including desktops, laptops, peripherals, and mobile devices.
* Troubleshoot and resolve common hardware and software issues.
* Deliver a high\-quality, customer\-focused service experience in a timely manner.


**Ticket Management**
* Receive, document, and close support requests in ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow).
* Prioritize tickets based on urgency and impact.
* Escalate complex or unresolved issues following defined protocols.


**Hardware Deployment \& Recovery**
* Assist with or independently perform workstation deployments, device imaging, and equipment setup.
* Support device recovery, re\-imaging, and e\-waste processes according to lifecycle guidelines.
* Ensure accurate labeling, tagging, and asset tracking for all deployed equipment.


**Inventory \& Asset Management**
* Maintain and reconcile inventory of IT equipment and accessories at assigned site.
* Use asset tracking systems to manage device records, check\-ins/outs, and stock levels.
* Participate in regular audits and support logistics for shipping/receiving hardware.


**AV \& Conference Room Support**
* Perform regular checks and basic troubleshooting of AV equipment (displays, microphones, cameras).
* Set up and tear down conference room tech for meetings or events.
* Support room readiness, monitor usage, and report or resolve AV issues.


**Documentation \& Process Compliance**
* Follow documented processes and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for all support tasks.
* Maintain clear and concise documentation for resolutions, escalations, and asset updates.
* Adhere to Astreya and client\-specific protocols, including change and incident management.


**Customer Service \& Communication**
* Serve as a visible, approachable point of contact for IT\-related issues at the site.
* Communicate effectively with users to understand issues and set clear service expectations.
* Represent Astreya’s service commitment with professionalism and courtesy.


**Level II Additional Responsibilities**
**Team Collaboration**
* At Level II, act as the lead or sole technician on\-site and coordinate with remote teams or vendors.
* Provide informal mentorship to junior techs or new team members visiting the site.
* Share site\-specific insights or recurring issue trends to help improve service delivery.


**Education And/or Work Experience Requirements**
****Level I****
* Required: High School Diploma or GED
* Preferred: Enrollment in IT\-related coursework or vocational training
* Certifications (plus): CompTIA A\+ Google IT Support Certificate or similar entry\-level credential


****Level II****

* Preferred:Associate’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field Prior experience working independently or at a single\-technician site


****Certifications****
* CompTIA A\+ and/or Network\+

You check the team calendar for scheduled events, review your ticket queue, and log into the contact support portal. The days moves along as you and the team you are a part of are solving physical security operational issues across the Americas.  Ready to Protect What Matters?

 Join us. Secure the future.

**Job Description**
 IT Support Specialist

Think of yourself as someone who provides assistance and technical support to the business and to team members who are experiencing technical, hardware, or software issues. * Other tasks will include maintaining an inventory of computer hardware assets, peripherals, and software licenses owned by the company; and perform scheduled preventive maintenance of computer systems.

 maintenance, and repair; has vast working knowledge of I.T. requirements/demands in
   

  

 call center operations and corporate organizations \- particularly in the area of Operations support; We need someone with above\-average problem\-solving,
   

  

 decision\-making, and analytical skills
   

  

* Big plus if you are a skilled technical writer \- able to document problems and solutions for


 customers and other technical support personnel.
   

  

* You have good time and project management skill
* Excellent English communication skills \- both spoken and written
* You are adaptive to changing work schedules and working hours; excellent customer


 orientation and interpersonal, customer care skills

Inclusive and equitable practices are our responsibility as a business. TaskUs is committed to providing equal access to opportunities.  CyberArk Operations Support Analyst is responsible for supporting the day\-to\-day operations of the CyberArk Privileged Access Management (PAM) platform. This includes managing the CyberArk infrastructure, monitoring system performance, and providing first\-level support to resolve issues related to privileged account management. * Assist in the administration and maintenance of the CyberArk PAM solution, including the management of safes, platforms, and policies.
* Monitor the health and performance of the CyberArk environment, responding to alerts and notifications in a timely manner.
* Provide first\-level support for issues related to privileged account access, including password checkouts, session management, and account onboarding.
* Participate in the onboarding of new accounts into the CyberArk platform, ensuring compliance with security policies and best practices.
* Collaborate with the cybersecurity team to implement enhancements and updates to the CyberArk infrastructure.
* Document standard operating procedures, system configurations, and incident reports.
* Assist in the development and delivery of CyberArk user training and awareness programs.
* Support internal and external audits by providing necessary documentation and evidence related to CyberArk operations.
* Stay up\-to\-date with the latest CyberArk features, updates, and industry best practices.
* Perform routine maintenance tasks such as patching, upgrades, and backups of the CyberArk environment


**Preferred Skills:**
* Basic understanding of cybersecurity principles and practices.
* Familiarity with Windows and Unix/Linux operating systems.
* Knowledge of Active Directory and LDAP is a plus.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, team\-oriented environment.
* Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies and challenges.
* Any experience with CyberArk or other PAM solutions is beneficial but not required.
* Certifications such as CyberArk Defender or Sentry are desirable but not mandatory for entry\-level applicants

title: SharePoint Support Specialist [T500-29192]
description:
**About Stolt\-Nielsen:** 




 Stolt\-Nielsen is a family\-founded global leader in bulk\-liquid and chemical logistics, transportation, and storage, known for its commitment to safety, service excellence, and innovation. At the Stolt\-Nielsen Digital Innovation Centre, we bring this legacy into the future — building smarter systems, driving digital transformation, and shaping what's next for the world of logistics. Here, you’re encouraged to think boldly, challenge convention, and help move today’s products toward tomorrow’s possibilities.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 As a SharePoint Support Specialist at Stolt\-Nielsen, you will be the first point of contact for SharePoint Online issues across the organisation, providing responsive P1 and P2 support and ensuring the platform runs smoothly day to day. You will manage site provisioning, permissions, lifecycle management, and the integration touchpoints between SharePoint and other Microsoft 365 applications.
 



 This role combines operational support with hands\-on administration, and requires strong problem\-solving ability and clear communication, since you will frequently be the one translating technical permission structures into plain language for end users and stakeholders. You will handle site creation and decommissioning, manage permissions and access reviews across multiple levels of the SharePoint and OneDrive environment, execute lifecycle management tasks (inactive site detection, owner attestation follow\-ups, archival), and support minor customization requests.
 



 You will work within a small, focused SharePoint team alongside a Team Lead and Senior Developer, with real opportunity to improve your technical skills over time.
 



  





**What You'll Do:** 



* Provide P1 and P2 support for all SharePoint Online issues across the organisation, acting as the first point of contact for end users.
* Manage day\-to\-day site provisioning, configuration, and decommissioning in line with governance policies.
* Administer permissions across all levels of the environment, including:
* Site\-level and sub\-site permissions
* Ownership assignment and transfer
* Guest\-level (external user) permissions and access reviews
* Folder\- and item\-level (unique) permissions
* OneDrive\-level sharing and access permissions
* Security group membership and Microsoft 365 group permissions
* Diagnose and resolve permission\-related issues logically and systematically, tracing access problems back to their root cause (e.g. broken inheritance, conflicting group membership, expired guest access) rather than applying quick fixes.
* Execute lifecycle management tasks including inactive site detection, owner attestation follow\-ups, and archival processes.
* Support integration touchpoints between SharePoint and other Microsoft 365 applications such as Teams, OneDrive, Outlook, and Viva Engage.
* Log, track, and report on support tickets; maintain SLA compliance and provide regular reporting on ticket volumes and resolution times.
* Communicate clearly and proactively with end users and stakeholders — explaining permission issues, timelines, and resolutions in an accessible, non\-technical way.
* Handle minor customisation requests such as page layouts, list configurations, and basic workflow adjustments.
* Assist with permission audits and access reviews in support of governance and compliance requirements.
* Maintain clear, well\-structured documentation for support procedures, known issues, permission models, and environment configurations.
* Perform additional duties and projects as assigned.



  





**What You'll Bring:** 



* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in IT, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of experience in SharePoint Online administration within a Microsoft 365 enterprise environment.
* Strong, demonstrable understanding of SharePoint's permission model, including site, sub\-site, folder/item\-level, guest, and OneDrive permissions, and how inheritance and breaking inheritance affects access.
* Solid understanding of security groups and access management.
* Experience with site provisioning, lifecycle management, and governance processes.
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365 ecosystem integration (Teams, OneDrive, Outlook, Viva Engage).
* Basic PowerShell scripting skills for administrative tasks and bulk operations.
* Strong problem\-solving and logical thinking skills, with the ability to methodically diagnose and resolve complex access and permission issues.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong service orientation with excellent communication and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple support requests, prioritise effectively, and work under SLA pressure.
* Attention to detail and commitment to thorough documentation.



  





**Must\-Have Skills:** 



* SharePoint Online administration and site management
* In\-depth knowledge of SharePoint permissions: site, sub\-site, folder/item\-level, guest access, and ownership management
* OneDrive permissions and sharing management
* Microsoft 365 permissions management and security groups
* Site provisioning, lifecycle management, and governance
* Incident management and SLA\-driven support
* Basic PowerShell scripting
* Strong problem\-solving and logical/analytical thinking
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills



  





**Nice\-to\-Have Skills:** 



* Experience with Power Automate for basic workflow automation
* Familiarity with SharePoint migration processes
* Knowledge of Microsoft Purview or other compliance and governance tools
* Experience with ticketing systems (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or similar)
* Exposure to Power Apps or SharePoint Framework (SPFx) development

* Establish and maintain monitoring and alerting for availability, performance and errors.
* Monitor and optimise platform performance, database usage and environment capacity.
* Identify capacity constraints before they become incidents, and plan accordingly.



  





**Incident and problem management:** 



* Act as the escalation point for platform\-related issues, coordinating with OutSystems Support where needed.
* Lead root cause analysis and drive preventive maintenance so the same incident does not recur.
* Maintain runbooks and operational documentation to a standard others can actually follow.



  





**Upgrades and maintenance:** 



* Plan, perform and document platform upgrades, patches and scheduled maintenance, working with our development and infrastructure teams.
* Oversee database management on SQL Server, including backups, schema evolution and performance tuning.



  





**Development and automation (20%):** 



* Build automation that removes manual operational steps, deployment scripts, health checks, environment provisioning, routine reporting.
* Integrate OutSystems into our CI/CD pipelines alongside the DevOps team.
* Develop and maintain reusable platform components, integrations and shared services used across applications.
* Provide hands\-on technical support to OutSystems developers on integration, performance and architecture questions.
* Contribute to architecture discussions and help define our operational standards for low\-code environments.



  





**What you'll bring:** 



* Proven experience managing OutSystems platforms in an enterprise, multi\-environment setup.
* Strong understanding of OutSystems architecture across front\-end, service and integration layers.
* Working knowledge of OutSystems Lifetime, Service Center, Integration Studio and the Infrastructure Management Console.
* Practical database administration experience\-Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle or similar.
* Working knowledge of Azure infrastructure, PaaS components and network and security fundamentals.
* Familiarity with DevOps principles, CI/CD tooling and automation scripting in PowerShell, Python or Bash.
* Excellent documentation skills and a genuine eye for operational detail.
* The ability to work with developers, infrastructure teams and security specialists to keep the platform healthy and aligned with our wider goals.



  





**Must\-have skills:** 



* 5\+ years in IT operations, platform administration or DevOps roles.
* 3\+ years of OutSystems platform administration experience.
* Strong knowledge of OutSystems Lifetime and environment management.
* Database management on SQL Server or Oracle.
* Platform monitoring, maintenance and troubleshooting.
* Understanding of OutSystems ALM, deployment flows and dependency management.
* Familiarity with networking, firewalls and identity management using Azure AD or Entra ID.



  





**Nice to have:** 



* Scripting for operational automation at scale, rather than one\-off fixes.
* Experience introducing monitoring or observability tooling to a platform that lacked it.
* Exposure to OutSystems Developer Cloud (ODC).
* Experience supporting a geographically distributed user base across time zones.



  





**How we'll measure success:** 



* Our environments are stable, and unplanned downtime is rare and short.
* Deployments are routine and low\-drama, following a consistent ALM process.
* Recurring manual tasks reduce over time because they have been automated away.
* Platform documentation is current enough that a colleague can pick up an incident without you.

title: Trading Desk IT Support Engineer (L2 / L2+)
description:
**About the Company**
---------------------


Swan Solutions \& Services Pvt. Ltd. is a leading IT Infrastructure and Digital Transformation company with over 36 years of industry experience. Headquartered in Mumbai, Swan is a ₹1,400\+ Crore organization delivering IT Infrastructure, Cloud, Cybersecurity, Networking, Virtualization, Storage, and Managed Services to leading enterprise customers.


Swan is a technology partner with leading organizations including HP, Cisco, Microsoft, VMware, and NetApp.


**About the Role**
------------------


We are looking for an experienced **Trading Desk IT Support Engineer (L2 / L2\+)** to support mission\-critical trading applications in a live market environment. The role involves proactive monitoring, troubleshooting, production support, and ensuring minimal downtime for critical trading operations.


**Location:** Worli, Mumbai – Client Site
  

**Industry:** BFSI / Capital Markets
  

**Experience:** 4–6 Years
  

**Employment Type:** Full Time / Contract


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Provide L2 support for trading applications including **Omnesys (NEST), NEAT, BOLT, and Greek**.
* Manage and troubleshoot **FIX connectivity and related issues**.
* Perform **EOD/BOD activities** for trading applications and risk management tools.
* Handle critical production issues during live market hours with minimal downtime.
* Deploy patches and upgrades across UAT and Production environments.
* Install, configure, and maintain servers supporting trading applications.
* Support infrastructure at **NSE, BSE, and MCX Colo Data Centers**.
* Manage **Active Directory, user access, and permissions**.
* Monitor trading networks and support low\-latency infrastructure.
* Coordinate with vendors for issue resolution and technical escalations.
* Perform daily backup activities and ensure security compliance.
* Support **Bloomberg terminals** and other trading\-related applications.

**Required Skills**
-------------------


* Strong experience in a **Trading / Capital Markets environment**.
* Hands\-on experience with **NEST / NEAT / BOLT** or similar trading applications.
* Strong knowledge of **FIX Protocol and connectivity**.
* Proven experience in **L2 Production Support**.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a high\-pressure, live trading environment.
* Good communication skills with the ability to interact with traders and dealers.

**Good to Have**
----------------


* Exposure to **Algo Trading** environments.
* Experience with **NSE/BSE/MCX Colo Data Centers**.
* Knowledge of **VMware / Virtualization**.
* Understanding of cybersecurity and IT security practices.
* Experience supporting similar **BFSI / Capital Markets clients**.

**Preferred Candidate**
-----------------------


* Immediate joiners or candidates with a **short notice period** are preferred.
* Candidates with prior experience supporting **trading infrastructure or BFSI clients** will be preferred.

**What We Offer**
-----------------


* Opportunity to work in a **mission\-critical trading environment**.
* Exposure to advanced trading applications and infrastructure.
* Opportunity to work with enterprise BFSI and capital market technologies.
* Fast\-paced learning and professional growth.

**Ready to Join Us?**
---------------------


If you have strong experience in **Trading Application Support, FIX Connectivity, Capital Markets Infrastructure, and L2 Production Support**, we’d love to hear from you.


**Apply today and become a part of Swan Solutions \& Services Pvt. Ltd.**

title: Manager, Help Desk
description:
**Description**
**Who We Are**
 Scale Computing is a global leader in edge computing, hyperconverged infrastructure, and managed networking solutions. We deliver innovative, secure, and scalable technology that powers critical operations worldwide.
   

  

**Summary**
 The Help Desk Manager is responsible for the overall operational health of Scale Computing's IT systems and the leadership of the Help Desk/System Administration team in India as well as fostering open communications with the US Help Desk/System Administration counterparts. This position's primary focus is on people management, process optimization, and service delivery. While management is the core of your day\-to\-day, you will maintain a technical edge, acting as a point of escalation for complex issues that require expert intervention.
   

  

 You will manage the lifecycle of IT tickets, ensure adherence to Service Level Agreements (SLAs), oversee critical infrastructure (Systems/Network), and drive the professional development of your direct reports. The ideal candidate is a seasoned IT leader who can balance high\-level technical strategy with day\-to\-day operational excellence.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
 Operational Leadership: Manage the daily operations of the IT Helpdesk and Systems Administration functions, ensuring 24/7 (coordinating with the US Manager/Teams) coverage and rapid resolution of incidents.
   

  

 People Management: Recruit, train, coach, and conduct performance reviews for a blended team of SysAdmins and Helpdesk technicians.
   

  

 Strategic Planning: Assist senior leadership in planning IT budgets, resource allocation, and technology roadmaps.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Team Leadership \& Management


 Lead, coach, and manage a team of Systems Administrators and Helpdesk Support staff.
   

  

 Conduct regular 1:1s, performance appraisals, and career development planning for direct reports.
   

  

 Manage staff scheduling, on\-call rotations, and resource allocation to ensure coverage during critical business hours.
   

  

 Foster a culture of accountability, internal customer service excellence, and continuous learning.
   

  

* Helpdesk \& Service Delivery


 SLA Management: Define, monitor, and enforce Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for ticket response and resolution times using Jira Service Management.
   

  

 Incident Management: Serve as the primary point of escalation for high\-priority or complex technical issues that the team cannot resolve.
   

  

 Trend Analysis: Analyze ticket data to identify recurring issues and implement root\-cause fixes to reduce ticket volume.
   

  

 Onboarding: Oversee the "New Hire" process to ensure first\-day productivity for new employees (hardware, accounts, access).
   

  

* Infrastructure \& Systems Oversight


 System Governance: Oversee the administration of core enterprise systems, including JumpCloud, Google Workspace, Dialpad, and Atlassian Suite (Jira/Confluence).
   

  

 Network Strategy: Supervise the health of the network infrastructure (Fortinet firewalls, switches, routers), ensuring the team performs timely firmware updates and security patching.
   

  

 Asset Management: Manage IT asset lifecycle (procurement, inventory tracking, and retirement) for the India office and remote workforce.
   

  

* Security \& Compliance


 Policy Enforcement: Ensure all IT operations comply with internal security policies and external frameworks (PCI\-DSS, CIS Controls, SOC2\).
   

  

 Audit Readiness: Collaborate with the Information Security team to maintain documentation and evidence for security audits.
   

  

 Risk Management: Proactively identify risks in the IT environment and propose mitigation strategies.
   

  

**Success Metrics for the Role**
 Team Performance: High retention rates and positive feedback on team performance reviews.
   

  

 Operational Efficiency: Consistently meeting or exceeding SLAs for helpdesk ticket resolution.
   

  

 System Uptime: Maintenance of 99\.9% uptime for core internal systems and network infrastructure.
   

  

 Project Delivery: Successful oversight of completion of IT infrastructure projects on time and within budget.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Required Education and Experience:**
 Experience: 8\+ years of total IT experience, with at least 3\+ years in a people management or team lead role (managing performance, hiring, etc.).
   

  

 Technical Background: Strong background in Systems Administration (Linux, Windows, macOS) and Networking. You must be technical enough to validate your team's work.
   

  

 Process Knowledge: Demonstrated experience with ITIL frameworks (Incident, Problem, and Change Management).
   

  

 Tools: Proficiency in modern IT management stacks, specifically JumpCloud, Jira Service Management, and Google Workspace.
   

  

 Language: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English are mandatory for cross\-region collaboration.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or Business Administration.
   

  

 Certifications: ITIL Foundation/Practitioner, PMP (Project Management Professional), or technical certs like CISSP/CISM or Fortinet NSE.
   

  

 Experience managing vendors and procurement processes in India.
   

  

**Working Conditions \& Physical Demands**
 Position Type: Full\-Time, In\-Office/Hybrid
   

  

 Hours of Work: Standard business hours (7am\-4pm IST, 2pm\-11pm IST) to overlap with US operations, with flexibility required for critical escalations.
   

  

 Physical Demands: Primarily sedentary; may require oversight of physical equipment setup.
   

  

**Benefits**
* Group medical insurance
* Casual dress code
* Hybrid work schedule
* Paid company holidays
* Cab facilities
* Fully stocked snacks at office
* Vibrant and inclusive workplace atmosphere
* Flexible work environment with growth opportunities


 Scale Computing is an equal opportunity employer. Final candidates will be subject to a pre\-employment background check

title: Global Contract Logistics Information Systems IT Support Engineer
description:
**It's more than a job**
 As part of the Contract Logistics team at Kuehne\+Nagel, you will play a key role in designing, managing, and optimizing solutions that keep goods moving efficiently. Whether you’re leading a team, engineering processes, or driving projects, your work ensures that our customers’ products are stored, handled, and delivered with precision. From everyday essentials to seasonal items, what we do in Contract Logistics impacts businesses and communities around the world. At Kuehne\+Nagel, your contribution goes far beyond the warehouse—it helps shape the flow of global trade.
   

  

 ‎
   

  

 As a Senior IT Support Engineer, you will take a leadership role in delivering advanced technical support to our customers and partners, tackling highly complex issues that require deep technical expertise and innovative problem\-solving. You will act as a subject matter expert, guiding junior team members, driving resolution for escalated cases, and collaborating closely with cross\-functional teams.
   

  

 In this role, you will be instrumental in shaping the direction of support processes and strategies, contributing to the continuous improvement of our products and services. Your responsibilities will include identifying systemic challenges, proposing robust solutions, and influencing technical roadmaps to enhance customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.
   

  

**How you create impact**
* Handle and resolve application incidents and service requests.
* Analyse, troubleshoot, and provide solutions to complex technical issues.
* Own support tickets and ensure timely resolution and communication.
* Escalate issues to relevant technical teams when required.
* Conduct root cause analysis and implement preventive solutions.
* Monitor system performance and proactively address potential issues.
* Maintain documentation and knowledge base for effective knowledge sharing.
* Collaborate with IT, business, development teams, and external vendors.
* Ensure compliance with standard processes and SLAs.
* Drive process improvements and support strategic IT projects.
* Mentor team members and provide expert technical guidance.
* Work in shifts when required.


**What we would like you to bring**
* Professional education or degree in IT, or equivalent work experience. Advanced certifications (e.g., ITIL, Microsoft, Cisco, AWS, or similar) are a plus.
* Strong ability to analyse and solve technical problems.
* Ability to learn fast and become proficient with unfamiliar systems.
* Proficient communication skills in English, both written and verbal.
* Experience with relational databases and SQL.
* Proficiency in Unix/Linux, with experience in shell scripting and system diagnostics.
* Experience working with monitoring tools (e.g., Nagios, Grafana, or similar) and log analysis tools (e.g., Splunk, ELK).
* Knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, VPNs, and firewalls.


**What's in it for you**
 At Kuehne\+Nagel, you’ll be part of a global logistics leader that believes in creating real impact on business, on customers, and on careers. Here’s what you can look forward to:
   

  

* Global Exposure: Step into a world of international opportunities with a presence in 100\+ countries.
* People\-Centric Culture: Join a team where your voice matters and people genuinely care.
* Learning \& Development: Grow with us personally and professionally through world\-class training and career pathways.
* Innovation \& Sustainability: Be part of a future\-focused company driving real change in logistics and the planet.
* Rewards \& Recognition: Get rewarded for your passion, performance, and potential.
* Stability with Agility: Enjoy the best of both worlds a trusted global brand with a startup spirit.


**Who we are**
 Logistics shapes everyday life \- from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne\+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.
   

  

 As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life\-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.

description:
**About the company:** 




  





 Resillion helps organisations build technology they can trust. Our work matters because today’s digital world is connected and increasingly complex. From software and platforms to devices, media, AI and critical business systems, our teams help clients make sure their products and services work as they should.
 



  





 We’re the only company who combine quality engineering, cyber security, conformance and interoperability, and media content quality control into something we call Total Quality. We combine human insight with advanced AI to deliver solutions that support performance from concept to launch.
 



  





 Resillion is also a place to grow. We're a team of curious, collaborative experts who care about doing things well. You’ll be trusted to bring your ideas, take ownership and keep learning, with support from colleagues across our global business. We value expertise and the different perspectives people bring \- creating an environment where you can build a career with confidence.
 



  





**Job Title:** 
 Technical IT Support Engineer
 



**Reports to:** 
 IT Manager / Head of IT
 



**Location:** 
 Hybrid / Bangalore
 



**Department:** 
 IT / Infrastructure Support
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 We are looking for an experienced and hands\-on Technical IT Support Engineer with 6 to 9 years of strong end\-to\-end IT support experience. This role is ideal for someone who has worked across modern IT environments and is comfortable supporting users, systems, tools, cloud platforms, networks, and business applications in a fast\-paced setup.
 



 The person should have in\-depth experience across Microsoft 365, Azure, Windows, Linux, Networking, Endpoint Support, Security Basics, and AI\-enabled productivity tools. The role requires someone who can troubleshoot quickly, communicate clearly, and support both day\-to\-day IT operations and continuous improvement initiatives.
 



 This is a highly practical role for someone who enjoys solving problems, supporting users, improving processes, and working with multiple technologies in a dynamic environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**IT Support \& User Management** 




 · Provide hands\-on technical support for end users across hardware, software, network, and application\-related issues.
 



 · Manage user accounts, access requests, permissions, groups, licenses, and basic identity\-related troubleshooting.
 



 · Support onboarding and offboarding activities, including device setup, application access, and system readiness.
 



 · Troubleshoot issues related to laptops, desktops, printers, VPN, Wi\-Fi, email, Teams, and business applications.
 



 · Ensure tickets are handled within agreed timelines while maintaining a strong user experience.
 



  





**Microsoft 365, Azure \& Cloud Support** 




 · Support Microsoft 365 services including Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, Exchange Online, and basic admin activities.
 



 · Assist with Azure\-related support including user access, basic cloud administration, identity management, and troubleshooting.
 



 · Work with Intune or endpoint management tools for device compliance, configuration, and application deployment.
 



 · Support security and access controls such as MFA, password resets, conditional access basics, and account protection.
 



 · Help users adopt M365 and AI\-based tools effectively to improve productivity.
 



  





**Infrastructure, Networking \& Systems Support** 




 · Troubleshoot network\-related issues including LAN, WAN, VPN, DNS, DHCP, Wi\-Fi, firewalls, and connectivity problems.
 



 · Provide support across Windows and Linux environments, including installation, configuration, patching, and basic administration.
 



 · Monitor and support endpoint performance, system availability, and common infrastructure issues.
 



 · Assist with backup checks, asset tracking, inventory management, and IT documentation.
 



 · Coordinate with vendors, service providers, and internal teams to resolve escalated technical issues.
 



  





**AI Tools, Automation \& Process Improvement** 




 · Support and guide users on AI productivity tools, including Microsoft Copilot or similar AI\-enabled workplace tools.
 



 · Identify opportunities to automate repetitive IT support tasks and improve service efficiency.
 



 · Create and maintain knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides, and standard operating procedures.
 



 · Contribute to IT improvement projects, system upgrades, migrations, and new tool rollouts.
 



 · Stay updated with emerging technologies and bring practical ideas to improve internal IT operations.
 



  





**Required Skills \& Experience** 




  





 These must already be established and not skills to be developed in the role.
 



 · 6 to 9 years of hands\-on experience in IT support, infrastructure support, or technical support roles.
 



 · Strong experience supporting Microsoft 365 services such as Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, and Exchange Online.
 



 · Practical experience with Azure, Entra ID / Azure AD, user access management, MFA, and basic cloud administration.
 



 · Strong troubleshooting experience across Windows desktop/server environments.
 



 · Good working knowledge of Linux systems and basic command\-line troubleshooting.
 



 · Solid understanding of networking concepts including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, LAN/WAN, Wi\-Fi, and firewall basics.
 



 · Experience supporting endpoint devices, laptops, desktops, printers, peripherals, and remote users.
 



 · Familiarity with ITSM tools, ticketing systems, SLA management, and incident/request handling.
 



 · Experience working with AI tools, automation tools, or modern workplace productivity platforms.
 



 · Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment with multiple priorities and quick turnaround expectations.
 



 · Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to non\-technical users.
 



 · Good documentation skills and experience maintaining support guides, asset records, and process documents.
 



 · Strong ownership mindset, attention to detail, and ability to work independently.
 



  





**Desirable Skills \& Qualifications** 




  





 · ITIL Foundation certification or good understanding of IT service management practices.
 



 · Microsoft certifications related to M365, Azure, Endpoint, or Security.
 



 · Experience with Microsoft Intune, Defender, Autopilot, or endpoint management platforms.
 



 · Experience with PowerShell scripting or basic automation.
 



 · Exposure to cybersecurity best practices, endpoint protection, vulnerability management, and compliance.
 



 · Experience supporting global users or working in a multi\-location environment.
 



 · Knowledge of backup tools, monitoring tools, and remote support platforms.
 



  





**Why Join Us?** 




  





 We’re looking for someone who doesn’t just close tickets but actively improves how IT support is delivered. If you have strong technical depth, hands\-on troubleshooting experience, and the ability to support users across Microsoft 365, Azure, AI tools, networking, Linux, and Windows in a fast\-paced environment, we would like to hear from you.

title: IT Support Associate II
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. OTS IT provides nonstop global IT support to Amazon Operations as a vital piece to the puzzle. We take ownership for what we do — whether supporting IT infrastructure, developing new technology in\-house, launching a new Amazon Operations facility, or delighting our customers by delivering packages directly to them.OTS IT provides global IT support to Amazon Operations, including Fulfillment, Sortation, Logistics, and Last Mile...  

  

About The Role  

Ops Tech IT Support Engineers will be responsible for utilizing their skills to provide assistance to the operations team in resolving technical problems within these sites that cover a multitude of technical disciplines. The IT Support Engineers position is the first level of support for the operations of the Amazon Sites and becomes the voice and face of the IT department to our customers.
  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:  

Maintenance of IT equipment throughout the Fullfillment sites.  

Troubleshooting of all IT related equipment such as PCs, wireless handheld devices, thin clients, printers and other end user devices.  

Manage RMA and repair process for all devices under warranty.  

Support the Senior Engineers in daily projects and activities as directed.  

We have a 5\-day work week but given the 7 days a week operation, the 2 scheduled days off will vary based on shift patterns and business needs.  

The position will require supporting of multiple buildings around the area and flexible to travel to sites with in the state /region.  

Ensure all safety procedures are adhered to while performing work


**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 1\+ years of corporate setting Windows, Mac or Linux Operating systems support experience
* Experience troubleshooting integrated and interdependent computer systems
* Experience maintaining zebra thermal printers, troubleshooting thin clients, PCs, scanners, and portable handheld terminals

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* CompTIA A\+, CompTIA Network\+, Cisco/CCNA, Linux (Redhat), Microsoft hardware (installation), AWS, or other industry relevant certifications
* Experience in a dynamic environment with a high degree of customer service

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information.  **www.bydeluxe.com** 




  





**Position Summary** 




 The Domestic Support Technician is in place to respond professionally and timely to all requests, inquiries and issues presented by exhibitor clients (theatres), motion picture studios, and all other callers contacting Deluxe Cinema Support. The technician is well versed in procedures and internal systems to resolve issues rapidly and with high efficacy. Key responsibilities include answering calls and emails to fulfill requests, troubleshoot issues and escalate as necessary in accordance with studio guidelines and SLAs.

* Professionally answer inbound Cinema Support calls and resolve inquiries or concerns swiftly per guidelines ensuring resolution.

* Create KDMs (Key Delivery Management) per studio guidelines, which give specific dates and times for play of digital features.
* Possess and exercise the ability to make sound judgment when negotiating issues that arise from troubleshooting. This includes having the skill to determine appropriate actions and rapid prioritization of issues and steps to prevent dark screens.
* Ability to generate required reports from systems, as well as read and utilize information.
* Provide feedback and suggestions to management for improved customer satisfaction, process improvements and system enhancements.



**REQUIREMENTS – Describes the professional experiences, educational background, knowledge, and behavior required to fulfill the role responsibilities** 



* Must demonstrate a positive attitude, able to handle self professionally in a high stress situation, project self as a team player, ability to accept and manage change and provide process improvement, cost saving and customer satisfaction suggestions.

* Must be organized, reliable, conscientious, flexible, and skilled at multi\-tasking.
* Work effectively under pressure and possess strong organizational and interpersonal skills.
* Possess strong decision making and problem\-solving skills.

* Experience in defining, documenting, and implementing business processes and procedures.
* Knowledge of the 24\-hour clock, time zones, and state abbreviations preferred.
* Experience in a Customer Service organization, and/or Technical Operations Services including hardware/software systems and connectivity monitoring and troubleshooting highly desired.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills are needed to communicate effectively to all levels of the organization as well as internal and external customers.
* Basic computer networking skills and familiarity with the cinema environment is a must.
* Understanding of basic networking technologies such as TCP/IP, FTP, multicast, etc. is a plus.
* Experience with incident management systems and web\-based applications required.
* Strong customer service skills focused on problem solving and customer satisfaction.
* Knowledge of military time, time zones, and ISO Country abbreviations.

* Ability to sit for an extended time up to an entire shift.

description:
**We help the world run better**
 At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.
   

  

 Enhanced Operations Service Specialist plays a pivotal role within the SAP PCO – Global Cloud Operation Delivery (GCO) \- Enhanced Operations Service (EOS) organization, serving as a trusted advisor responsible for safeguarding and optimizing strategic customers' investments in SAP Enterprise Cloud Services.
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced SAP technology professional expert for the Enhanced Operations Service (EOS) team who should have a proven track record in at least in one of the areas like SAP Basis, HANA DB, Server management, Critical Situation Handling, Project Management, with a strong technical and process background. A customer first mindset is a must.
   

  

 As an EOS Execution Service Senior Specialist \- you are responsible for:
   

  

* Ensure the execution of planned changes requested by customers are completed as per the activity schedule, tracking, and achieving various ambitious service KPI and SLA’s.
* Own and execute customer service requests, system build, migration, and operational activities across Basis, DB, and Server domains — meeting SLA/KPI commitments with a customer\-first mindset.

* Drive feedback relevant to procedure and process with relevant teams and drive it to completion.
* Coordinate and orchestrate the work between the various teams with Strong collaboration with other units within and outside Enterprise Cloud Service units.
* Bring in Continuous Improvement Initiatives, to address customer pain points and enhancements in the Service Delivery
* Process improvement initiatives for daily operational activities
* Streamline standard operating procedures by focussing on automation enhancements.
* Leverage AI\-driven insights to enhance process, SR delivery, system observability, reliability, and proactive issue resolution.


**What You’ll Build**
* Excellent hands\-on experience in one of the areas like SAP Basis, Lifecycle events (Upgrades / Updates). Support Knowledge of products like SAP Cloud\-Connector, S4 would be an added advantage.
* Practical knowledge with SAP technologies like SAP NetWeaver, Business Objects, SAP HANA and SAP Sybase Adaptive Server Enterprise (ASE)
* Experience with Managed/Hosting services or SAP Private Cloud or Public Cloud Operations/Support is preferred.
* Working knowledge on SAP Application Security, System Copies, DB export\-import, and disaster recovery strategy, client administration is preferred.
* Experience in working with Linux pacemaker environment is added advantage.


**What You Bring**
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in one of the following areas: Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technologies Management.
* 8 to 13 years of work experience as a Technical SAP NetWeaver Consultant (ABAP and Java Basis Administration)
* Hands\-on expertise in SAP Basis administration, SAP NetWeaver, SAP HANA, Sybase ASE, and Business Objects.
* Strong knowledge of S/4HANA architecture, migration paths, high availability, and disaster recovery strategies.
* Experience with hyperscale cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and managed/private cloud operations.
* Proficiency in Linux/UNIX, Linux Pacemaker, scripting (Shell, Python, Perl), and automation tools (Ansible, Chef).
* Working knowledge of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, NAT, firewalls, LDAP) and storage.
* Familiarity with additional SAP technologies: Cloud Connector, Content Server, OpenText, IDM, TREX, MDM, and others.
* ITIL framework exposure; SAP S/4HANA conversion and OS/DB migration certifications are added advantage
* 24\*7 support model. Rotational 2 shift support of APJ and EMEA time zone. Rotational weekend support
* Analytical and solution\-oriented thinking
* Strong customer service focus with customer first Mindset.


**Where You Belong**
 SAP Private Cloud Operation (PCO) is part of the Customer Services \& Delivery board area in SAP. Enterprise Cloud Services is a business unit focusing on delivery of managed private cloud services. To provide our customers with the right level of service, we have Technical and customer facing roles within the unit along with technical delivery.
   

  

 The Enhanced Operation Service is part of SAP PCO GCO Delivery organization. This is a dedicated team which will focus on leading and optimizing strategic customers’ end\-to\-end delivery and operation model, during the customer’s cloud transformation journey. We provide a spectrum of cloud deployment options for our customers with our own infrastructure, our partners and through public cloud infrastructures.

 SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end\-to\-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose\-driven and future\-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.

 SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well\-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best.  is responsible for delivering technical solutions that enable global Life Sciences organizations to successfully adopt and utilize IDBS software. As part of the Professional Services organization, this role supports the implementation, integration, testing, and operational readiness of IDBS products, including IDBS E\-WorkBook and IDBS Polar, while partnering with cross\-functional teams to solve technical challenges and drive successful customer outcomes.
   

  

 This position reports to the
 **Regional Services Operations Manager** 
 and is part of the Global Professional Services team based in
 **Bengaluru, India** 
 . This is an on\-site role. You will work with enterprise integrations, APIs, data exchange, testing, and solution delivery to support complex laboratory informatics implementations for global Life Sciences customers.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To**
* Support the implementation, configuration, and integration of IDBS software solutions, including E\-WorkBook and Polar, for leading global Life Sciences organizations.

* Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

* Experience supporting laboratory informatics, scientific software, LIMS, ELN, or other Life Sciences technology platforms.

title: System Administrator
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **System Administrator** to manage, configure, and continuously improve an enterprise platform based on customer and business requirements.

The role involves **user access management, system configuration, module administration, workflow automation, dashboards, issue management, and customer coordination**. You will work closely with customers and internal stakeholders to implement approved requests, resolve system\-related issues, and ensure the platform operates efficiently.

The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience administering an **enterprise, work\-order management, facilities management, SaaS, or similar business platform**, along with strong communication, troubleshooting, problem\-solving, and configuration skills.

Key Responsibilities

User Access Management

* Create, modify, and deactivate user accounts based on approved requests.
* Manage user roles, permissions, and access levels.
* Maintain accurate access controls and system governance.
* Ensure access requests are completed accurately and within required timelines.

Customer Communication \& Issue Management

* Communicate system performance issues, service updates, and system changes to customers.
* Coordinate with customers and internal stakeholders during system\-related issues.
* Provide clear updates on issue status, resolution progress, and planned improvements.
* Track customer questions and requests through to completion.

Feature Requests \& System Improvements

* Review customer suggestions, enhancement requests, and system feedback.
* Work with internal stakeholders to assess the feasibility of requested changes.
* Implement approved configuration changes based on customer requirements.
* Communicate decisions, timelines, and progress to customers.
* Identify opportunities to improve system usability and operational efficiency.

Module Administration

Manage customer requests and configurations across various platform modules, including:

* Locations and Provider Assignments
* Asset Management
* Refrigerant Tracking
* Site Planning
* Inventory Management
* Supply Manager Administration
* Planned Maintenance

Process Configuration \& Optimization

* Update business hours and user/location\-level settings.
* Configure multi\-level invoice and proposal approval processes.
* Implement automated invoice approval workflows.
* Review existing workflows and identify opportunities for simplification and automation.
* Ensure configuration changes meet customer requirements and business processes.

Dashboard \& System Configuration

* Configure dashboards based on customer reporting and operational requirements.
* Manage issue\-list settings for accurate issue tracking and resolution.
* Maintain configuration consistency and data accuracy across the platform.
* Test configuration changes before implementation.
* Document important system and configuration changes.

Required Qualifications

* **4\+ years of experience** in System Administration, Platform Administration, Application Administration, SaaS Administration, or similar roles.
* Hands\-on experience administering an **enterprise, work\-order management, facilities management, or business operations platform**.
* Experience managing user accounts, roles, permissions, and system configurations.
* Strong understanding of system configuration and workflow management.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong customer and stakeholder management skills.
* Good troubleshooting and problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to manage multiple customer requests and priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with internal and external stakeholders.

Preferred Skills

* Experience with **Facilities Management (FM)** or **Work Order Management** platforms.
* Knowledge of **invoices, proposals, planned maintenance, assets, inventory, locations, and provider management**.
* Experience configuring **dashboards, workflows, approval processes, and automation**.
* Familiarity with **issue tracking, system testing, and configuration documentation**.
* Experience working with **SaaS or enterprise applications**.
* Exposure to customer support or technical/application support environments is an advantage.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who can take ownership of **system administration**, understand customer requirements, implement configurations accurately, troubleshoot system\-related issues, and proactively identify opportunities to improve platform processes and operational efficiency.

**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Experience:** 4\+ Years  
**Work Location:** Bengaluru, Karnataka

Pay: ₹800,000\.00 \- ₹1,400,000\.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Have you supported US clients? Are you comfortable working the required US shift?
* How have you managed users, roles, permissions, and access provisioning?
* Do you have 4\+ years of experience in System Administration, Platform Administration, Application Administration, or SaaS Administration?
* Which enterprise/SaaS, Facilities Management, Work Order Management, or business platform have you administered? What were your key responsibilities?
* Describe your experience with system configuration, workflows, approval processes, or automation.

Work Location: Bangalore (Hybrid)

We are looking for a dedicated and technically strong Technical Support Engineer – AMS to join our growing support operations. If you enjoy solving technical issues and ensuring seamless user experience, this role is a great fit for you.

You will be responsible for diagnosing computer hardware and operating system issues, providing resolutions, and guiding users through step\-by\-step solutions. You will work closely with internal teams to ensure consistent and high\-quality support delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Support

Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve issues related to computer hardware, operating systems, and related peripherals.

Provide remote technical assistance through phone, email, or tickets.

Guide users with step\-by\-step resolutions for both basic and advanced technical concerns.  
Document issues, resolutions, and escalations accurately in the ticketing system.

Customer Experience

Communicate clearly and professionally with customers across different channels.

Maintain strong customer satisfaction by ensuring timely and effective support.

Collaborate with cross\-functional teams for escalations and complex problem\-solving.

Shift \& Work Flexibility

Willingness to work in rotational shifts and accommodate weekly offs accordingly.

Comfortable with a hybrid working model, with flexibility to operate from KTP or ECP depending on organizational requirements.

Required Qualifications

Graduate, preferably BCA or equivalent technical background.

1 to 4 years of relevant experience in technical support or IT helpdesk roles.

Strong understanding of computer hardware, OS concepts, system configurations, and troubleshooting methods.

Good English communication skills, both verbal and written.

Ability to multitask and work in a fast\-paced support environment.

Preferred Skills

Experience working with ticketing tools (ServiceNow, Jira, Freshdesk, etc.)

Knowledge of basic networking (LAN, Wi\-Fi, IP configuration)

Ability to follow SOPs, SLAs, and documentation standards

Strong problem\-solving and analytical mindset

Opportunity to work in a dynamic and supportive team

Growth opportunities based on performance and skill development

title: IT Support Associate
description:
**Company Overview**
 Metayb is a digital transformation company on a mission to transform seamlessly by empowering organisations to navigate the vast landscape of the digital\-first era. Within just three year of inception, we have grown into a close\-knit family of 500\+ employees, each possessing rich field expertise. Metayb focuses on fostering seamless customer experiences, enhancing operational efficiency \& deriving actionable insights. By harnessing the power of emerging tech Metayb aims to be the unparalleled choice for global customers, delivering strategic goals effectively within a digital first ecosystem of value creation. Our key areas of expertise lie in Digital Transformation, Data Science, SAP Implementation, Workflow Automation, Dashboarding, Visualization, Finance and Supply Chain services. We strongly aspire to venture into IOT, AI/ML \& Virtual Reality. Metayb endeavours to be best\-in class across digital solutions, infrastructure, and product engineering.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are looking for a motivated
 **IT Support Associate** 
 to provide day\-to\-day technical assistance to employees and support the organization's IT infrastructure. The role involves troubleshooting hardware, software, network, and user\-access issues while maintaining proper IT documentation and asset records.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Provide first\-level support for laptops, desktops, printers, applications, and peripherals.
* Troubleshoot basic LAN, Wi\-Fi, VPN, Internet, DNS, and DHCP issues.
* Install, configure, and maintain operating systems and approved software.
* Support user onboarding/offboarding, account setup, and IT equipment allocation.
* Manage and update IT support tickets and ensure timely resolution.
* Maintain accurate IT asset inventory and documentation.

title: System Administrator
description:
**Job description:**

Job Overview:  
We are seeking a skilled Windows and Network System Administrator with expertise in VMware technologies to manage our Windows\-based infrastructure, virtualized environments, and network systems at Rhinexa India Pvt. Ltd. This role focuses on administering Windows Server, Active Directory, Exchange, VMware virtualization, basic networking, and antivirus solutions while handling day\-to\-day system administration tasks. The ideal candidate will excel in communication and problem\-solving to support users and maintain seamless operations.

Key Responsibilities:

* Administer Windows Server environments (e.g., Windows Server 2016/2019/2022\), including installation, configuration, patching, and troubleshooting.
* Manage Active Directory services, including user/group management, Group Policy Objects (GPOs), domain controllers, and LDAP integration for secure access control.
* Oversee Microsoft Exchange Server or Microsoft 365 Exchange Online, managing email configurations, mailbox policies, spam filtering, and high availability.
* Deploy and manage VMware virtualization platforms (e.g., VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter), including virtual machine creation, resource allocation, and performance optimization.
* Monitor and maintain network infrastructure, including routing, switching, VPNs, and firewall configurations to ensure connectivity and security.
* Implement and manage antivirus and endpoint protection solutions (e.g., Microsoft Defender, TrendMicro, Kaspersky) to detect and mitigate security threats.
* Handle day\-to\-day system administration tasks, such as user account provisioning, hardware/software troubleshooting, backups, restores, and system performance tuning.
* Perform VMware\-related tasks, including vMotion, DRS, HA configurations, and integration with Windows and network environments.
* Provide technical support to end\-users via ticketing systems, remote assistance, or on\-site help, communicating solutions clearly and effectively.
* Collaborate with IT teams on system upgrades, migrations (e.g., to Azure AD, hybrid cloud, or VMware\-based solutions), and maintain detailed documentation.
* Conduct system audits, vulnerability assessments, and compliance checks to align with Rhinexa’s cybersecurity and operational standards.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 3\+ years of experience in system administration, with strong expertise in Windows Server, Active Directory, Exchange, and VMware technologies.
* In\-depth knowledge of Windows technologies, including Active Directory (AD DS, AD FS), Group Policies, and PowerShell scripting for automation.
* Proficiency in VMware vSphere, ESXi, and vCenter, including VM management, clustering, and storage configurations (e.g., vSAN).
* Familiarity with Microsoft Exchange administration, including hybrid setups, DAGs (Database Availability Groups), and Outlook/OWA integration.
* Basic understanding of networking concepts (e.g., TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs) and tools for monitoring network performance.
* Experience with antivirus/EDR solutions and best practices for malware protection and incident response.
* Certifications such as Microsoft MCSA/MCSE, VMware VCP\-DCV, or CompTIA Network\+ are highly preferred.
* Excellent communication skills to explain technical concepts to non\-technical users and document procedures clearly.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills to manage complex, day\-to\-day IT challenges independently or collaboratively.

Preferred Skills:

* Knowledge of backup solutions (e.g., Veeam, VMware vSphere Data Protection) and disaster recovery planning.
* Familiarity with ITIL practices for incident, problem, and change management.
* Basic scripting skills (e.g., Python, PowerShell) for automating Windows and VMware tasks.

Pay: From ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Education:

* Diploma (Required)

Experience:

* System administration: 3 years (Required)

Shift availability:

* Day Shift (Preferred)
* Night Shift (Preferred)

Willingness to travel:

* 50% (Required)

Work Location: In person

Your team is driven by customers and you will help drive the success of Google Cloud by understanding and advocating for customers’ issues.

title: Workday Analyst
description:
**Company overview:**
 TraceLink is the world’s largest Agentic Business Network, enabling life sciences and healthcare companies to build and manage a scalable digital workforce of governed, no\-code AI agents that execute and coordinate mission\-critical supply chain operations alongside human teams. Powered by the Integrate\-Once™ OPUS platform, TraceLink links more than 300,000 network participants, enabling multi\-enterprise processes at global scale.
   

  

 Founded in 2009 with the simple mission of protecting patients, today Tracelink has 5 global offices, over 800 employees and more than 1700 customers in over 60 countries around the world. Our expanding product suite continues to protect patients and now also enhances multi\-enterprise collaboration through innovative new applications such as MINT.
   

  

 Tracelink is recognized as an industry leader by Gartner and IDC, and for having a great company culture by Comparably.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Workday Analyst combines hands\-on Workday configuration expertise with technical build skills to support and evolve the organization's Workday HCM platform. This role partners with HR and cross\-functional business stakeholders to gather requirements, configure and test system changes, and support integrations, reports, and calculated fields. The Analyst plays a key role in bi\-annual release management, day\-to\-day system support, data integrity, and delivery of HR technology projects, reporting directly to the Manager, HR Technology.
   

  

**Role \& Responsibilities**
* Partner with HR and business stakeholders to gather requirements, re\-design current processes, and configure new functionality to support growing business operations.
* Assist with ongoing Workday projects including application testing, implementation, enhancements/upgrades, report writing, and new functionality investigation and deployment.
* Diagnose and resolve end\-user, business process, and security issues; provide day\-to\-day support to HR and other Workday end\-users.
* Develop and maintain documentation of Workday business processes, configuration decisions, and support procedures.
* Perform routine audits for system data validation and integrity, and partner with key stakeholders to make necessary corrections.
* Assist with special projects and annual initiatives such as Open Enrollment, compensation review cycle, performance reviews, and year\-end processing.
* Configure and maintain business process framework, condition rules, and notifications across supported Workday modules.
* Support Workday security architecture, including domain and business process security policies, role\-based security groups, and periodic access reviews.
* Monitor integration event logs and resolve errors.
* Collaborate with other HRIT team members to research and resolve Workday system issues, unexpected results, or process flaws; recommend solutions or alternate methods to meet requirements.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with HR, Payroll, IT, and other business teams to ensure Workday configuration aligns with policy, compliance, and reporting needs.
* Serve as a subject\-matter resource on Workday capabilities, translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Support change management activities, including test scripts, training materials, and end\-user communications.


**Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience as a Workday analyst/administrator responsible for configuration, testing, and support across several Workday modules (e.g., HCM, Compensation, Benefits, Absence, Extend, Payroll, and others).
* Bachelors degree in information technology, human resources, business administration, or related field is required.
* Working technical proficiency with Workday integrations.
* Demonstrated ability to translate functional business requirements into system configuration and technical solutions.
* Strong and effective written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to collaborate with team members and business stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
