If you have questions about this privacy notice or need to contact us in connection with your personal data, including any requests to exercise your legal rights referred to at the end of this notice, please contact Candidate\-Privacy@tracelink.com.*

title: Expert Technical Support Engineer
description:
**Technical Support Engineer**
==============================

**Position Summary**
--------------------


We are seeking a skilled Technical Support Engineer to act as the critical link between Level 2 Support and Development teams. The role involves investigating, diagnosing, and resolving complex technical escalations across enterprise healthcare applications and secure messaging solutions.


The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Windows Server environments, SQL Server, HL7 interfaces, and application troubleshooting. This role requires excellent analytical skills, root cause analysis capabilities, and experience managing escalations through to resolution while maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Infrastructure \& Database Support**

* Troubleshoot issues within Windows Server environments.
* Utilize PowerShell for connectivity validation, service management, process monitoring, and system diagnostics.
* Manage certificates, security configurations, and Event Viewer analysis.
* Interpret and troubleshoot SQL Server and ODBC\-related errors.
* Monitor, execute, and support SQL Agent jobs.
* Perform SQL\-based troubleshooting and data integrity validations.

### **Application \& Integration Support**

* Trace and troubleshoot HL7 message flows and interface\-related issues.
* Investigate message queue backlogs and integration failures.
* Support secure messaging solutions and endpoint connectivity.
* Troubleshoot IIS, ASP.NET, and application\-layer issues.
* Review application configurations and identify root causes across the technology stack.

### **Escalation Management**

* Reproduce issues in test and production environments.
* Analyze and classify defects based on severity, frequency, and software versions.
* Gather diagnostic evidence including application logs, SQL traces, network traces, and user recordings.
* Document findings, workarounds, root cause hypotheses, and reproduction steps.
* Coordinate escalations between Support, Engineering, and Development teams.
* Manage incidents through ITSM platforms and track PRBs and defect tickets.

### **Documentation \& Client Communication**

* Communicate technical findings effectively to customers and stakeholders.
* Create and maintain Knowledge Base (KB) articles.
* Provide detailed troubleshooting documentation and escalation summaries.

**Required Skills**
-------------------

### **Operating Systems \& Infrastructure**

* Windows Server
* PowerShell
* Windows Services
* Event Viewer
* Certificate Management
* Citrix and Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI)

### **Web \& Application Technologies**

* IIS
* ASP.NET / .NET Framework
* Application Configuration Management
* Stack Trace Analysis
* Authentication and Security Tokens

### **Database Technologies**

* Microsoft SQL Server
* SQL Agent Jobs
* ODBC
* SQL Extended Events
* SQL Troubleshooting and Query Development

### **Integration Technologies**

* HL7
* Enterprise Interface Engines
* Secure Messaging Solutions
* Identity \& Access Management Systems
* EHR Integrations

### **Networking**

* TCP/IP
* DNS
* Firewalls
* Network Ports
* PKI and Certificate Management

### **Tools \& Platforms**

* Azure DevOps
* GitHub
* ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms
* Log Analysis and Diagnostic Tools
* AI\-enabled troubleshooting and automation tools

**Preferred Skills**
--------------------

* Browser Developer Tools
* Fiddler
* Wireshark
* Linux
* Docker
* Container Technologies
* Microsoft Azure
* Amazon Web Services (AWS)

**Preferred Domain Experience**
-------------------------------


Experience within Healthcare IT environments is highly desirable, including knowledge of:

* HL7 Workflows
* ADT (Admission, Discharge, Transfer)
* Patient Matching
* EHR Systems
* EDMS/DMR Platforms
* Clinical Workflows and Healthcare Integrations

**Key Competencies**
--------------------

* Advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis
* Environment isolation and issue reproduction
* Escalation and incident management
* Defect classification and release mapping
* Strong customer communication skills
* Technical documentation and knowledge management
* Cross\-functional collaboration and stakeholder management

title: Senior IT Administrator (Global)
description:
Role: Senior IT Administrator (Global)  

  

About Us:  

  

AppZen is the leader in autonomous spend\-to\-pay software. Its patented artificial intelligence  

accurately and efficiently processes information from thousands of data sources so that  

organizations can better understand enterprise spend at scale to make smarter business  

decisions. It seamlessly integrates with existing accounts payable, expense, and card workflows  

to read, understand, and make real\-time decisions based on your unique spend profile, leading  

to faster processing times and fewer instances of fraud or wasteful spend. Global enterprises,  

including one\-third of the Fortune 500, use AppZen's invoice, expense, and card transaction  

solutions to replace manual finance processes and accelerate the speed and agility of their  

businesses. To learn more, visit us at www.appzen.com.  

  

About the Role:  

  

As a Senior IT Administrator (Global), you will work closely with the rest of our team to ensure  

that our company is using the most up\-to\-date technology to run our business. We are seeking  

a hands\-on IT administrator who will own the day\-to\-day reliability, security, and scalability of  

our hardware, software, and internal network, while directly supporting our staff across global  

offices.  

  

Roles and Responsibilities:  

  

* Administer, maintain, and support the company's IT infrastructure (network, endpoints,


servers, cloud accounts) across global offices.  

* Manage day\-to\-day IT operations, ensuring 24x7 availability and reliability of systems


and services.  

* Own the user onboarding and offboarding process, including access provisioning and


deprovisioning across systems.  

* Administer SaaS applications — user provisioning, license tracking, and renewal


coordination.  

* Execute the IT asset life cycle end\-to\-end: procurement, deployment, tracking, and


secure disposal.  

* Monitor systems and infrastructure proactively; troubleshoot, resolve, and escalate


incidents within SLA.  

* Support the CISO/security function on day\-to\-day compliance tasks, security tooling


configuration, and audit evidence gathering.  

* Identify repetitive manual tasks and build automation (Shell/Python scripting, API


integrations) to streamline IT operations.  

* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to support integration projects and resolve


tooling gaps.  

* Maintain and enforce existing IT policies and procedures; flag gaps for review.
* Support business continuity and disaster recovery execution — testing, documentation,


and runbook upkeep.  

* Act as the escalation point for Tier 2/3 technical support and helpdesk operations.


Senior IT Administrator (Global) \| Confidential  

AppZen – Senior IT Administrator (Global) JD  

* Document processes, configurations, and runbooks to build team knowledge and reduce


single points of failure.  

* Coordinate with vendors on day\-to\-day support tickets, renewals, and issue resolution.
* Mentor junior IT staff and interns on troubleshooting approach and best practices.
* Track IT performance metrics (uptime, ticket resolution time, SLA adherence) and report


on trends.  

  

Experience and Qualifications:  

  

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.
* 2\-6 years of hands\-on experience administering IT infrastructure and operations;


experience in a global, multi\-office, or distributed\-team environment preferred.  

* Strong working knowledge of network administration, endpoint management, and SaaS


application administration.  

* Practical experience with automation/scripting (Shell, Python) to streamline recurring IT


tasks.  

* Comfortable working in a startup/scale\-up environment. This role will require occasional


overlap with US/UK time zones.  

* Working knowledge of ITIL\-aligned support processes (incident, change, and problem


management).  

* Hands\-on experience integrating applications via APIs.
* Good communication skills, with the ability to support end users and collaborate across


cross\-functional teams.  

* Prior experience mentoring junior team members or interns is a plus.

title: Tower Lead - ServiceNow
description:
**Hello,**
**FCM part of FCTG** 
 is one of the world’s largest travel management companies and a trusted partner for nationals and multinational companies. With a 24/7 reach in 97 countries, FCM’s flexible technology anticipates and solves client needs, supported by experts who provide in\-depth local knowledge and duty of care as part of the ultimate personalised business travel experience.
   

  

 As part of the ASX\-listed Flight Centre Travel Group, FCM delivers the best market\-wide rates, unique added\-value benefits, and exclusive solutions.
   

  

**Winner of the World's Leading Travel Management Company Award at the WTM for nine consecutive years (2019\-2011\),** 
 FCM is constantly transforming the business of travel through its empowered and accountable people who deliver 24/7 service and are available online and offline. FCM has won the coveted
 **Great Place to Work certification for the fifth time** 
 ! FCM Travel India is one of India’s Top 100 Great Mid\-size Workplaces 2024 and the Best in Professional Services.
   

  

 A leader in the travel tech space, FCM has proprietary client solutions. FCM provides specialist services via FCM Consulting and FCM Meetings \& Events.
   

  

**Summary**
 The ServiceNow Tower Lead is the assistant team leader for the ETS ServiceNow team, responsible for the end\-to\-end delivery of ITSM support, project engineering, and platform maintenance, based in the Global Capability Centre. The Tower Lead operates with a high degree of independence, owning solution design and delivery for standard BAU and ITSM work, and coordinating with onshore design leads for major or complex projects where additional design authority is required.
   

  

 Operating within the SIAM framework as part of an internal service provider function, the Tower Lead enables the offshore team to function as a capable, self\-directing delivery unit — maintaining quality, throughput, and platform standards with little routine onshore dependency. The Tower Lead is a senior technical practitioner who leads by example, uplifts team capability, and holds full delivery accountability within the offshore context.
   

  

**Day In The Life**
**Offshore Delivery Leadership**
* Lead and coordinate the offshore ServiceNow development team across BAU support, project delivery, and platform maintenance workstreams.
* Manage daily stand\-ups, sprint ceremonies, and team workflow, driving a high\-performing delivery cadence with minimal onshore direction required.
* Act as the primary escalation point for the development team, resolving blockers and maintaining momentum through active, technically\-grounded leadership.
* Allocate work across the development team based on capacity, skillset, and priority, optimising throughput without compromising quality.
* Foster a culture of ownership and continuous improvement within the team, setting clear expectations for delivery standards and individual accountability.


**Solution Design and Technical Authority**
* Own end\-to\-end solution design for all BAU ITSM work and small projects, translating business requirements into well\-defined technical specifications and acceptance criteria without requiring onshore input (except where a Technical Business Analyst is also assigned).
* Engage with internal business customers to understand requirements, conduct discovery, and propose fit\-for\-purpose ServiceNow solutions aligned to platform best practices and FCTG standards.
* For major or complex projects, receive design artefacts and functional specifications from design leads, interpret these accurately, and direct the team in executing against the agreed design.


**You'll Be Perfect For The Role If You Have**
**BAU Support Coordination**
* Oversee the offshore team's response to BAU ServiceNow support tickets, ensuring SLA adherence and customer experience standards are maintained independently of onshore involvement.
* Triage incoming support requests, assign to appropriate developers, and track resolution to closure.
* Identify recurring issues or systemic defects and initiate remediation or platform improvement actions within the team's remit, escalating only where broader platform decisions are needed.
* Maintain awareness of platform incidents and manage support team contribution to resolution activities.


**Testing and Release Coordination**
* Oversee the QA function and ensure test plans, test cases, and defect tracking align to agreed acceptance criteria and standards.
* Coordinate release packaging and submission through ETS change management processes, ensuring all governance requirements are met prior to deployment.
* Ensure all release artefacts, documentation, and post\-release validation activities are completed to standard.


**Governance and Reporting**
* Maintain accurate sprint and delivery reporting to support visibility of the team's productivity, quality, and capacity.
* Contribute to standards, documentation, and knowledge base maintenance in Confluence, ServiceNow and Sharepoint.
* Adhere to change management, release, and governance processes as defined by FCTG, ensuring relevant activity is auditable and compliant.


**Work Perks! \- What’s in it for you:**
 FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.
   

  

 You will be rewarded with competitive market salary. You will also be equipped with relevant training courses and tools to set you up for success with endless career advancement and job opportunities all over the world.
   

  

**Market Aligned remuneration structure** 
 and a highly competitive salary
   

  

**Fun and Energetic culture** 
 : At the heart of everything we do at FCM is a desire to have fun and be yourself
   

  

**Work life Balance** 
 : We believe in “No Leave \= No Life” So have your own travel adventures with paid annual leave
   

  

**Great place to work** 
 \- Recognized as a top workplace for 5 consecutive years, which is a testimonial of our commitment towards our people
   

  

**Wellbeing Focus** 
 \- We take care of our employee with comprehensive medical coverage, accidental insurance, and term insurance for the well being of our people.
   

  

**Paternity Leave:** 
 We ensure that you can spend quality time with your growing family
   

  

**Travel perks** 
 : You'll have access to plenty of industry discounts to ensure you continue to broaden your horizons
   

  

**A career, not a job** 
 : We believe in our people brightness of future. As a high growth company, you will have the opportunity to advance your career in any direction you choose whether that is locally or globally.
   

  

**Reward \& Recognition** 
 : Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering \- You'll have to experience it to believe it!
   

  

**Love for travel** 
 : We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
   

  

**We value you...**
 Flight Centre Travel Group is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace that supports your unique identity to create better, safer experiences for everyone. We encourage you to come as you are; to foster inclusivity and collaboration. We celebrate you.
   

  

**Who We Are...**
 Since our beginning, our vision has always been to open up the world for those who want to see.
   

  

 As a global travel retailer, our people come from all different backgrounds, and our connections spread to the far reaches of the globe \- 20\+ countries and counting! Together, we are a family (we call ourselves Flighties).
   

  

 We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve. We embrace new experiences, we celebrate the wins, seize all opportunities, and empower all of our people to find their
 **Brightness of Future.**
 We encourage you to
 **DREAM BIG** 
 through collaboration and innovation, and make sure you are supported to make incredible ideas a reality. Together, we deliver quality, innovative solutions that delight our customers and achieve our strategic priorities.
   

  

**Irreverence. Ownership. Egalitarianism**

 The Amazon Helpdesk is the first place for Amazon employees to go with technical questions and problems with Amazon's desktops, laptops, mobile devices, network services and software. The Amazon Helpdesk works with Amazon and Amazon service managers and other staff to maintain internal solutions and respond to employees’ technical issues. Additionally, they manage all the on\-premise infrastructure including servers, network device, telephony and printers.
   

  

 Amazon.com is looking for a dynamic and motivated IT Support Engineer to join their IT Services Team. If you are customer\-focused with strong problem\-solving skills and have experience with Chrome OS and Windows environments, we want to talk with you.
   

  

 As a member of the team you will have the opportunity to develop your career by maintaining and supporting Amazon’s unique corporate infrastructure, service platforms and employees. This is a challenging role that demands strong communication skills, technical, analytical and problem\-solving competencies and most importantly, customer obsession.

* Provide ticket\-based, walk\-up and remote Helpdesk support for Amazon’s growing multi\-site user base and environments.
* Direct internal and external service provider engagements, as needed, in the processing of support requests for effective and timely resolution of issues.
* Manage various routine processes such as new hire onboards, computer life cycle management, asset management, computer imaging, hardware warranty support and hardware recycling.
* Participate in the development, implementation and administration of processes and procedures to ensure the reliability, recoverability, and optimum performance of user hardware and local services.
* Work in tandem with the rest of the IT Operations team to uphold system SLAs with a rotating On\-call schedule for production support issues.
* Research, procure, vet and deploy new hardware and software solutions.


 A day in the life
   

  

 Seeking a customer\-focused IT Support Associate who excels in Windows/Mac/Linux OS deployment, remote technical support, and comprehensive user hardware/software/peripheral assistance, while demonstrating expertise in LAN troubleshooting and hardware asset management. The ideal candidate will maintain detailed documentation while handling a high volume of urgent requests, displaying innovation, energy, and adaptability in new processes. They must be self\-motivated, able to work independently with minimal supervision, and maintain high productivity levels while managing ambiguous situations. This role requires someone who combines strong technical capabilities with genuine curiosity, commitment to team success, and an initiative in delivering hands\-on IT support across all platforms.

* 3\+ years of corporate setting Windows, Mac or Linux Operating systems support experience

Professional communication style for emails, escalations, outage updates, and stakeholder interactions.

description:
**Position Summary**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 L1 Support role involves monitoring bots and automated processes to ensure smooth execution and timely completion of tasks. The role includes handling basic incidents, troubleshooting common issues, and escalating critical problems to higher support levels. It also focuses on maintaining system stability by performing routine checks and ensuring minimal disruption to business operations.
   

  

**Job Function And Responsibilities**
 L1 Support (UiPath \& Python Automation)
   

  

* Manage and monitor UiPath environments, particularly UiPath Orchestrator, including bot configuration, job monitoring, queue management, code migrations, assets management and first\-level troubleshooting of automation failures
* Basic understanding of Python, AWS, GitHub \& Shell scripting
* Monitor bot schedules, queues, and triggers through UiPath Orchestrator and supporting tools to ensure timely and successful automation runs.
* Perform initial RCA and troubleshooting of automation failures, including application issues, data discrepancies, environment errors, and credential problems.
* Analyze error logs, execution reports, and alerts to identify common issues and apply predefined fixes or workarounds.
* Handle incident tickets and service requests within defined SLAs, documenting root cause, resolution steps, and outcomes clearly.
* Restart jobs, reprocess failed transactions, and perform basic production support activities.
* Provide Python script support, including validating script execution, resolving basic runtime errors, and coordinating fixes with development teams when required.
* Escalate complex or unresolved issues to developers with appropriate diagnostic details and evidence
* Maintain and update runbooks, SOPs, and knowledge base articles for recurring issues and standard resolutions.
* Ensure compliance with security, access, and change management processes while supporting production automations.
* Participate in daily monitoring, health checks, and shift handovers, ensuring continuity of support.
* Support minor enhancements, configuration updates, and bot parameter changes under guidance and approved processes.
* Perform cross\-functional coordination, working closely with infrastructure, development, QA, automation, and operations teams to resolve incidents and ensure seamless automation delivery
* Follow SDLC and ITIL processes, actively participating in Change Advisory Board (CAB) activities by preparing change documentation, supporting approvals, and executing approved changes/code migrations
* Assist with database operations (Oracle/MySQL), including understanding schema structures, executing basic queries, and troubleshooting connectivity impacting automations


**Qualification**
* B.E. (preferably in Computer Science or IT)
* Atleast 2 years experience in RPA and UIPath
* Applied knowledge of AWS
* Applied knowledge of Python, Shell scripting
* Experience in Github
* Willing to work in rotational shift (across 3 shifts) and weekend support for planned maintenance


**About Us**
 Onity Group Inc. is a leading non\-bank financial services company providing mortgage servicing and originations solutions through its subsidiary, Onity Mortgage, formerly known as PHH Mortgage. Onity Mortgage is one of the largest servicers in the country, focused on delivering a variety of servicing and lending programs to customers, clients and investors.

We operate through the lens of the customer, understand the importance of homeownership, and take pride in helping homeowners. Collectively this fosters long\-term relationships, ensuring our customers feel valued and supported. We expect all employees to interact with and engage our colleagues and our customers with respect, courtesy and professionalism, and to achieve results consistent with our service delivery standards.

Our commitment to inclusion and equal opportunity ensures that we sustain our reputation as an outstanding place to work, a great business partner and a valued community member. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. **The Role**
 As a
 **Akeneo Support** 
 , you are passionate about experience innovation and eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible. You bring
 **6\+ Years** 
 of experience, a growth mindset and a drive to make a lasting impact.
   

  

**You Will Thrive In This Role If You Are:**
* A curious problem solver who challenges the status quo
* A collaborator who values teamwork and knowledge\-sharing
* Excited by the intersection of technology, creativity and data
* Experienced in Agile methodologies and consulting (a plus)
* Role Responsibilities
* Experience Level: 6\+ Years


 Primary Technology: Akeneo PIM \- hands\-on experience in identifying and resolving PIM contribution/data issues
   

  

**Secondary Technology:** 
 Salesforce B2C Commerce (SFB2C) — hands\-on experience in identifying and resolving storefront/data reflection issues
   

  

 (Both skills require actual hands\-on issue resolution experience, not just conceptual/functional familiarity.)
   

  

**Good to have:** 
 MuleSoft, Content Management Systems (e.g., Oracle Commerce Business Control Center (BCC)), Oracle SQL
   

  

****Role Overview:****
 We are looking for an experienced L2 Support Engineer for a rotational support team, responsible for hands\-on troubleshooting of issues across both Akeneo PIM and Salesforce B2C Commerce (SFB2C) — analyzing problems from the point of PIM data contribution through to final data reflection on the storefront.
 **Key Responsibilities**
 Hands\-on troubleshooting of Akeneo PIM issues — data contribution errors, workflow failures, enrichment/export issues
   

  

 Hands\-on troubleshooting of SFB2C issues — data ingestion, catalog sync, storefront display/reflection issues
   

  

 Analyze end\-to\-end data flow — from PIM contribution through integration/middleware until data reflects correctly on the SFB2C storefront
   

  

 Perform root cause analysis (RCA) across both systems for recurring or complex data issues
   

  

 Collaborate with L1/L3 teams and cross\-functional stakeholders to drive resolution within SLA
   

  

 Participate in 24/7 rotational on\-call/shift support
   

  

 Document known issues, fixes, and runbooks for the support knowledge base.
   

  

****Required Skills \& Experience****
 5\+ years of overall IT/technical support experience
   

  

 Hands\-on experience troubleshooting Akeneo PIM issues (catalog management, product enrichment, workflows, data export/import failures)
   

  

 Hands\-on experience troubleshooting SFB2C issues (storefront data sync, catalog feed issues, display/reflection problems)
   

  

 Ability to trace data flow issues end\-to\-end across PIM → integration/middleware → storefront
   

  

 Familiarity with API/integration troubleshooting (REST APIs, connectors, or middleware tools) — assumed relevant, confirm if applicable
   

  

 Strong analytical and RCA skills
   

  

 Willingness to work 24/7 rotational shifts
   

  

**Good to Have**
 Experience with e\-commerce data governance or catalog data quality processes
   

  

 Exposure to ticketing/ITSM tools (JIRA Service Management, ServiceNow, etc.)
   

  

 Basic scripting/SQL knowledge for data validation
   

  

****Soft Skills****
 Strong communication skills to interface with client/stakeholder teams
   

  

 Ownership mindset for issue resolution until closure
   

  

 Ability to work independently in a rotational shift environment
   

  

**Scope Of Work:**
 ) L2 Incident Resolution: Manage daily tickets in the support queue, including initial analysis, implementing workarounds, and ensuring timely acknowledgment and resolution within established Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
   

  

* Troubleshooting \& Diagnosis: Resolve advanced technical issues escalated from L1 support, conducting in\-depth troubleshooting and diagnosing complex problems across SFCC, PWA, and associated commerce applications. This includes analyzing application logs, errors, and alerts.


 Client Interaction: Serve as a primary technical contact for clients, providing clear and timely communication on incident status, resolution plans, and technical explanations.
   

  

 War Room Leadership: Lead and actively participate in "War Room" situations during critical outages or incidents, coordinating efforts with cross\-functional teams (development, QA, L2, DevOps, client) to drive rapid resolution. High reactivity and availability are key during these times.
   

  

 On\-Call Support: Provide dedicated on\-call support outside of standard business hours on a rotational basis to ensure 24/7 coverage for critical incidents. This is not shift\-based, but rather dedicated on\-call availability.
   

  

 Knowledge Management: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation, knowledge base articles, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides to empower L1/L2 teams and improve incident resolution efficiency.
   

  

 Collaboration: Work closely with development, QA, and DevOps teams to escalate complex issues, provide insights for permanent fixes, and support new feature deployments or platform upgrades.
   

  

 If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.
   

  

 Commitment to reaching all kinds of people
   

  

 We design experiences that work for all kinds of people \- and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity \& Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.
   

  

****The Benefits****
 This is a
 **Full Time** 
 position based in
 **Bengaluru/Pune/ Ahmedabad /Gurugram in India.**
**Beyond a Competitive Compensation Package, We Offer:**
* Flexibility, with remote and hybrid work options (country\-dependent)
* Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs
* Learning and development, with access to cutting\-edge tools, training and industry experts


 Our benefits are tailored to each location. Your Talent Partner will provide full details during the hiring process.

The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring secure, compliant, and efficient endpoint operations while supporting Windows 10/11 lifecycle management.

* Manage device enrollment, retirement, lock, wipe, and lifecycle operations as part of Endpoint Security \& Device Management.
* Administer Windows update and patch deployment rings, monitor rollout success, track compliance, and remediate failed systems.
* Manage Device Certificates and support secure device authentication and access management.
* Utilize PowerShell / Automation capabilities to streamline endpoint administration, reporting, and operational tasks.
* Support Device Compliance initiatives by monitoring endpoint health, policy adherence, and organizational security standards.
* Investigate endpoint management, compliance, and patch\-related incidents, and coordinate resolution activities.
* Contribute to disaster recovery testing, audit activities, compliance reviews, and maintenance of endpoint\-related records.
* Support Endpoint Monitoring activities and proactively identify device performance and management issues.

* Endpoint Security \& Device Management

 Knowledge

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Position: Forward Deployed Engineer
   

  

 Location: Bangalore
   

  

 ️ Working Days: Monday to Friday
   

  

 Experience Required: 6 months to 1 years
   

  

 Forward Deployed Engineer \|
   

  

**Solving agent problems across the lifecycle — build, deployment, tuning and steady state — measured on what the agent achieves.**
**About The Role**
 We are hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to solve agent problems wherever they occur in the lifecycle. During build, that means getting a configuration to actually do what the use case requires. Through deployment and tuning, it means finding why an agent underperforms and fixing it at the right layer. In steady state, it means holding an agent's numbers where they were promised and catching drift before a client does. The common thread is not a phase; it is that an agent is not performing and you are the person who makes it perform.
   

  

 Your scorecard is the agent's outcome metrics. Connectivity, engagement and the outcome rate the use case exists to move — per agent, per use case. Tickets closed, response times and patch counts are hygiene we will look at, never the measure. A month with forty tickets closed and a drifting outcome rate is a bad month; a month with four and every agent holding its numbers is a good one.
   

  

 This role sits in the application layer, not core platform. That has a consequence worth stating plainly: you are partly an SDE. A fix that only ever helps one client is the weakest version of your work. Because you hold more context than anyone on why agents fail in the field, you are expected to recognise when a recurring fix should become a platform capability every client can use, and then to build it — pairing with SDE 1 and SDE 2 to ship it properly.
   

  

 It is hands\-on and customer\-facing at once. You will read production code, logs, transcripts and configuration; reproduce faults; write and ship changes; and speak directly to a client's operations or IT counterpart about what went wrong and what you changed. An FDE who cannot form an independent technical opinion becomes a ticket router, and a ticket router cannot move an outcome metric.
   

  

 What you are walking into
   

  

 Several enterprise accounts are live on real customer timelines while the platform is under active build. Most of what changes customer\-visible behaviour here is not code — it is configuration: a prompt, a disposition taxonomy, a threshold, a routing rule — shipping through a thinner review path than code. And our worst defects are not escaped, they are undetected: a configuration fault once put a placeholder outcome on two thirds of one campaign's calls for about a month, and the client found it, not us. None of that should discourage you; all of it is why the role exists.
   

  

 What you are measured on
   

  

 One primary metric, four supporting ones. The supporting metrics explain a movement in the primary; they never substitute for it.
   

  

 Metric Definition, and how it can be gamed
   

  

**Agent Outcome Metrics (primary)**
 Connectivity, engagement and outcome rate per agent and use case, against the committed baseline. This is the scorecard. Counter\-metric: baselines are set once and not renegotiated downward after a bad month.
   

  

**Detection latency**
 Median time from a customer\-visible regression starting to someone at our client's knowing. A fault we find in an hour is an incident; the same fault found by a client in five weeks is an account risk.
   

  

**Root\-cause accuracy**
 Share of issues where the first fix held. Re\-opens mean a symptom was patched at the wrong layer. Counter\-metric: time to first response, so accuracy is not bought with indefinite investigation.
   

  

**Escalation precision**
 Share of items sent to core platform that were genuinely platform gaps, and share you resolved that never needed to go there. Both directions fail: over\-escalation taxes platform engineering, under\-escalation buries a real signal in patches.
   

  

**Reusability**
 Share of your fixes that became a configurable capability available to every client rather than a one\-account patch. A high patch count with zero productised output is a warning sign, not throughput.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

* Own agent performance, wherever the agent is in its lifecycle. Hold a current picture of every agent you touch: what outcome it exists to move, what it is moving this week, and what changed. When a number drifts, find out why before the client asks. Where the instrumentation to see the drift does not exist, building it is your work, not the reason it was invisible.
* Diagnose at the right layer before you change anything. Almost every issue arrives as a symptom. Place it first: context assembly, disposition or configuration error, or broken integration. These have different fixes and different owners, and a patch at the wrong layer holds for a fortnight and returns in a new shape. Read the transcripts, logs and configuration, and state a root cause you can defend.
* Treat configuration as production. A change to a prompt, a disposition taxonomy or a threshold changes what a customer experiences with no deployment at all. It gets a review, a version and a rollback path exactly as code does. Where a configuration change cannot yet be governed that way, closing that gap is your work. This is the single strongest belief we screen for.
* Sustain the trust loop with the client. Test, flag, patch, retest — visibly, on a cadence the client can see, during UAT and long after. In our verticals confidence is rebuilt by watching us find and fix our own faults, not by an absence of faults. Changes touching live campaign behaviour go out staged and reversible.
* Ship the fix, and the instrumentation that would have caught it. Every fix carries a second question: how would we have known sooner? A meaningful share of your output should be monitoring, alerting and evaluation coverage that turns the next instance of that fault into an alert rather than a client email.
* Build features with the SDEs, not requests for them. When a fix generalises, you take it to SDE 1 and SDE 2 as a designed capability — the problem, the evidence across accounts, and a proposal for how it should work — and you pair on building it. You hold the field context they do not; they hold the codebase depth you may not. Where a change touches core platform, the CTO is consulted before it is built, not after.
* Be the technical face on live accounts. You will speak directly to a client's operations and IT counterparts: what broke, why, what you changed, when it is verified. The CSM owns the relationship; you own the technical truth inside it. Being plain about a fault we caused buys more trust than a clean\-sounding account of a bad week.


 Who you will work with
   

  

 Stakeholder Your relationship with them
 **Chief Product Officer** 
 Your manager. Owns the application layer this role sits in. Reviews agent outcome metrics, reusability and escalation precision.
 **Chief Technology Officer** 
 Owns core platform engineering. Consulted when a change reaches into the platform, and the escalation point for genuine architecture gaps.
 **SDE 1 and SDE 2** 
 Your build partners. You bring the field context and the problem definition; you ship the generalised capability together.
 **Associate Product Managers** 
 Owns the change train and intake. Your changes ship under that discipline; your recurring\-failure patterns tell the APM where defects cluster.
 **Customer Success / Account Managers** 
 Own the customer relationship. They bring the escalation; you give the technical truth and a date you can defend.
 **Client operations and IT counterparts** 
 Your direct contacts on live accounts — CRM and telephony integrations, data issues, UAT and verification of fixes.
   

  

 What we are looking for
   

  

 Must\-haves
   

  

* At least 1 year building or running software in production. We are hiring on judgement and ownership, not tenure — but you must have shipped something real that other people depended on.
* Strong Python and comfort with SQL, and the ability to read an unfamiliar codebase and follow a request end to end through it.
* Hands\-on work with LLM applications: prompting, context assembly, retrieval, tool or function calling, and evaluation. If you have built an eval harness for a component whose output is a distribution rather than one correct answer, lead with that.
* Real debugging discipline — you can hold a hypothesis, test it, and discard it. We assess this on a live, messy artifact, not a whiteboard algorithm.
* API and integration work: REST, webhooks, queues, retries, auth, and the failure modes of somebody else's system that you cannot change.
* You treat configuration as production. If you have shipped systems governed by config, flags, rules or prompts, and have opinions on how those get reviewed, versioned and rolled back, say so early.
* Willingness to face a customer during a failure and be plain about it, and excellent written communication — root\-cause notes and change summaries are artifacts people act on. You will be assessed on writing, not asked about it.
* Comfort with ambiguity and half\-built process. You will operate without a runbook and then write the runbook.


 Nice\-to\-haves
   

  

* Voice or conversational AI: telephony, dialers, STT and TTS, latency and barge\-in behaviour, call\-quality debugging.
* Regulated environments — BFSI, insurance, healthcare — and the data\-handling, DPDP and audit gates that come with them.
* Observability tooling (Grafana, Looker, Metabase or equivalents), CRM and contact\-centre integrations, and Indian\-language deployments where transcription quality varies by language, accent and channel.


 Disqualifiers
   

  

* Treating a configuration change as exempt from release discipline because it is not a deploy.
* Patching symptoms — adjusting a prompt until a complaint stops, without a stated root cause.
* Escalating as a reflex, or the opposite: absorbing a genuine platform gap into patch work for months, and optimising for the queue while the agent's outcome metrics drift.
* Declaring something fixed because it worked in one test, on a component whose output is a distribution.


 What this role is not
   

  

* Core platform architecture and technical direction — layering, security model, technology choices (CTO).
* Release cadence, intake gating and cross\-service contract governance (TPM).
* Product roadmap ownership and prioritisation (Product, with your input from the field).
* Owning the customer relationship, WBRs and QBRs (CSM).
* Commercial scoping, pricing and renewal (AM).


 What success looks like
   

  

 By day 30
   

  

* You can state, for every agent you own, its intended outcome, current numbers and top two failure modes — without asking anyone.
* You have taken over the live\-issue queue end to end, and platform engineering has stopped being pulled into it by default.
* At least one recurring issue is traced to a root cause and fixed there, rather than at the symptom.


 By day 60
   

  

* Agent outcome metrics are holding at or above the baseline you measured in week one, and that baseline is written down.
* At least one customer\-visible regression was caught by us before the client raised it, and you can point at what caught it.
* At least one field fix has been generalised with the SDEs into a capability other clients can use.
* Every agent you touched has its configuration under version control and a reversible path to production.
* A written handover exists that would let a second FDE pick this up: known faults, baselines, patterns worth productising.

title: Analyst – IT Service Desk IND
description:
**About us:**  

OsbIndia (OSBI) is an offshore subsidiary of OSB Group. OSBI was incorporated in 2004 as a key part of the OSB Group’s business strategy to provide operational service support. OSBI works with the Group’s trading brands in the UK, providing exceptional customer support and service delivery to new and existing customers.
  
  

OSBI also prides itself on offering operational excellence by devising and utilizing process improvements and functional efficiencies.
  
  

The principal purpose of this role is to provide L1 Support to the end users related to technical IT queries and issues.
  
The role involves handling incidents, service requests and events ensuring delivery of IT services are of the highest standards to the Business.
  
The person fulfilling this role may need to travel to UK or Internationally as expected by the IT or Business for supporting migration, automation, or continual improvement related activities for a number of IT Services.
  
  

1\. Core Responsibilities
  
* First Point of Contact: As the first point of contact for end\-users, a ServiceDesk engineer is responsible for receiving, documenting, and prioritizing requests and incidents.
* Ticket Management: A ServiceDesk engineer is responsible for managing the ticket queue, ensuring that tickets are properly categorized, assigned and tracked to resolution.
* Troubleshooting and Support: A ServiceDesk engineer is responsible for providing technical support to end\-users, troubleshooting issues and resolving incidents within established service level agreements (SLAs).
* Communication and Customer Service: A ServiceDesk engineer is responsible for maintaining communication with end\-users, providing updates on incident status and resolution and ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction is maintained.
* Knowledge Management: A ServiceDesk engineer is responsible for maintaining and updating a knowledge base of common issues and their solutions, to improve efficiency and reduce resolution time.
* Escalation Management: A ServiceDesk engineer is responsible for escalating incidents to appropriate levels of support when necessary and ensuring that escalation paths are clearly defined and followed.
* Monitoring and Reporting: A ServiceDesk engineer is responsible for monitoring the health of IT systems, alerting appropriate support teams to issues and producing regular reports on incident trends and resolution times.
* Documentation and Process Improvement: A ServiceDesk engineer is responsible for documenting incident resolution procedures, identifying areas for process improvement, and contributing to the development and maintenance of IT service management (ITSM) processes and policies.
* Flexible to work in 24/7 rotational shifts to support End users and to monitor the health of IT Systems.
* Provide client / IT end users support and technical issue resolution via E\-Mail, phone and other electronic medium 24/7/365 days within agreed SLA and standards
* Support Clients / Internal Server – Network Infrastructure and coordinate with Service Owners / vendors for issues resolution and reporting
* Manage IT ServiceDesk tickets within SLA with minimal functional escalation.
* Assess recurring incidents and provide feedback on the accuracy of the Known Errors. Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs), Change Management Processes (CRP) and Problem Handling Procedures (PHP)
* Perform Windows (IT) / Core System operational tasks and report (E.g. Backups, Tape Rotation, VMWare, Antivirus reports etc.
* Perform operational tasks and business processes
* Maintain and manage checklists, standard reports etc.
* Provide out\-of\-hours support when required (Assigned on rotational basis)
* Create, update document/procedures etc. IT operation tasks using OSB / EG standard format in coordination with service owners
* Liaise with external suppliers / vendors
* Liaise with internal customers
* Undertake any other duties, commensurate with grade and job title, requested by Line Manager or above.
* As nominated Risk Champion for your function, work alongside the Risk function in developing and maintaining a risk management agenda, acting both to ensure the necessary levels of transparency for potential risks and promoting a positive culture of awareness and accountability throughout your function
* Maintain the company’s compliance standards and ensure timely completion of all mandatory on\-line training modules and attestations
* Performs moderately complex and varied tasks
* Guides and trains junior team members


2\. Experience Requirements
  
Essential
  
* 2 to 5 years of L1 technical support experience is essential
* Experience of working in a Windows/Citrix/VMWare/Active Directory and/or Applications service support role is essential
* Operating Systems: Experience in supporting and troubleshooting various operating systems such as Windows 10/11, MacOS and Linux.
* Software Applications: Familiarity with a range of software applications including productivity tools (e.g. Microsoft Office Suite), email clients, and web browsers.
* Remote Access: Experience in remote access technologies such as Remote Desktop, Virtual Private Network (VPN), and Remote Assistance.
* Incident Management, Knowledge Management and Service Request fulfilment.


Desirable
  
* Experience in working with ServiceNow (user level) or an equivalent ITSM system is desirable.


3\. Knowledge Requirements
  
Essential
  
* Excellent knowledge in Desktop support / End user computing / Applications support on Citrix platform/environment is essential.
* Hardware: Knowledge of computer hardware including desktops, laptops, printers, and mobile devices is essential.
* Networking: Understanding of basic networking concepts such as TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and VPN.


Desirable
  
* Knowledge of ITSM best practices is desirable.


4\. Skill and Competency Requirements
  
Essential
  
* Strong English language skills are essential (both written \& verbal).
* Good skills in respect of stakeholder management are essential.
* Good skills in respect of documentation, problem solving, analytical and time management are essential.
* User Administration: Ability to manage Office 365 user accounts, licenses, and permissions.
* Troubleshooting Skills: The ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues related to Office 365 applications and services.
* Active Directory User and Group Management: Knowledge of how to create, manage, and delete user and group accounts in AD is necessary for responding to requests related to access and permissions.
* Active Directory Account Lockouts: Knowledge of account lockout policies and troubleshooting account lockout issues is important for resolving issues related to user account lockouts.


Desirable
  
* PowerShell Scripting: Knowledge of PowerShell scripting for automating routine AD tasks and troubleshooting issues.


Why join OSBI?
  
  

We understand your career and how you progress is as unique as your individual personality. We've created a culture and an environment that encourages personal growth and offers our people opportunities to learn and succeed. Whether you're in the early stages of your career or already have an established profession, we're constantly seeking to hire talented individuals who want to make a difference and grow with us. We're a connected company working together to create a business in which we can all take pride and prosper.
  
If you want to know more about OSBI, please click on the website link: www.osb\-india.com
  
  

To know more about OSBI culture please find us on Instagram @OSBINDIA
  
  

To find out more about the roles \& updates please follow our LinkedIn Page www.linkedin.com/company/osbi.

### **Job Description**


**Job Description – Junior IT Administrator**  


We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic **Junior IT Administrator** to join our IT team and provide first\-level technical support across the organization. This role is ideal for someone with a strong foundation in IT support who is eager to learn and grow in areas such as Microsoft 365, Azure, endpoint management, networking, and IT operations.  


The successful candidate will support daily IT operations, assist with user onboarding and offboarding, troubleshoot hardware and software issues, and work closely with the Senior IT team to ensure a secure, reliable, and efficient IT environment. **Key Responsibilities**  

**End\-User Support**  

* Provide Level 1/2/3 IT support for hardware, software, printers, and peripheral devices.
* Troubleshoot Windows, Microsoft 365, email, Teams, and application\-related issues.
* Resolve user incidents and service requests within agreed SLAs.
* Escalate complex issues to senior team members when required.
* Assist users with remote support and troubleshooting.

 **Microsoft 365 Administration**  


Assist in administering Microsoft 365 services, including:  

* Exchange Online
* Microsoft Teams
* SharePoint Online
* OneDrive
* Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)
* Microsoft Intune (basic administration)


Responsibilities include:  

* User account creation and management
* Password resets
* License assignment
* Distribution groups
* Shared mailboxes
* Basic permission management

 **User Onboarding \& Offboarding**  

* Create and configure user accounts.
* Provision laptops and workstations.
* Configure Microsoft 365 accounts.
* Install required applications.
* Prepare new employee devices.
* Disable accounts and recover company assets during offboarding.
* Maintain onboarding and offboarding documentation.

 **Device \& Endpoint Management**  

* Configure desktops and laptops.
* Install and update operating systems and applications.
* Assist with Microsoft Intune device enrollment.
* Monitor device compliance.
* Perform routine system maintenance and patching.
* Maintain hardware inventory.

 **IT Operations**  

* Monitor IT systems and respond to alerts.
* Perform routine health checks on infrastructure.
* Assist with backups and recovery procedures.
* Support software deployments and upgrades.
* Maintain IT asset records and documentation.
* Follow IT security policies and operational procedures.

 **Networking Support**  

* Assist with basic networking tasks.
* Troubleshoot connectivity issues.
* Support VPN configuration and remote access.
* Assist with Wi\-Fi, DNS, DHCP, and printer configuration.

 **Documentation**  

* Update IT documentation and knowledge base articles.
* Document recurring issues and resolutions.
* Maintain asset registers and support records.

 **Continuous Learning**  

* Learn Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Intune, and cloud technologies.
* Participate in internal training and certification programs.
* Stay updated with new technologies and IT best practices.
* Support automation and process improvement initiatives where applicable.

 **Required Skills \& Experience**  

* 2\-4 years of experience in IT Support, Helpdesk, or System Administration.
* Good understanding of Windows 10/11 and Microsoft Office.
* Knowledge of Microsoft 365 administration.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD).
* Basic networking knowledge (DNS, DHCP, VPN, TCP/IP).
* Basic understanding of Active Directory.
* Experience with laptop and desktop troubleshooting.
* Strong problem\-solving and communication skills.
* Ability to prioritize tasks and work in a fast\-paced environment.
* Virtual Machines Troubleshooting

 **Preferred Qualifications**  

* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Microsoft Fundamentals certifications (MS\-900, AZ\-900, SC\-900\) are an advantage.
* Exposure to Microsoft Intune or Azure is desirable.
* Experience with ticketing systems such as ManageEngine, Jira, Zendesk, or ServiceNow is preferred.

 **Role Expectations**  


The Junior IT Administrator will:  

* Deliver timely and professional IT support to employees.
* Take ownership of assigned support requests until resolution.
* Follow established IT processes and security standards.
* Collaborate effectively with senior team members.
* Demonstrate a willingness to learn and continuously develop technical skills.
* Maintain a customer\-focused attitude while ensuring high\-quality service delivery.

title: IT Operations Administrator
description:
**Overview**
**Job Description:**
 We don’t simply hire employees. We invest in them. When you work at Chatham, we empower you — offering professional development opportunities to help you grow in your career, no matter if you've been here for five months or 15 years. Chatham has worked hard to create a distinct work environment that values people, teamwork, integrity, and client service. You will have immediate opportunities to partner with talented subject matter experts, work on complex projects, and contribute to the value Chatham delivers every day.
   

  

**WHY CHATHAM**
 We don’t simply hire employees — we invest in them. When you join Chatham, you are empowered with professional development opportunities designed to help you grow at every stage of your career, whether you’ve been here five months or fifteen years. You will have immediate opportunities to partner with talented subject\-matter experts, contribute to complex projects, and deliver the kind of value our clients depend on every day.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The IT Operations Team serves as the first point of contact for all technical issues across Chatham’s global organization. We partner closely with the Desktop Services, Infrastructure, Digital Workplace, and InfoSec teams to ensure that every end\-user technical issue is resolved thoroughly and without delay. Our reach spans five continents, and the work we do every day keeps Chatham’s people productive and connected.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The IT Operations Administrator is a senior\-level role within the IT Operations Team. In addition to handling a full scope of end\-user support responsibilities, the Administrator serves as a technical leader and mentor for junior analysts, owns the administration and continuous improvement of Chatham’s ITSM platform, and acts as a key liaison between front\-line support and senior IT stakeholders. This role demands a high degree of technical proficiency, sound judgment under pressure, and a genuine commitment to service excellence.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**End\-User Support \& Service Delivery**
* Serve as a primary point of contact for inbound technical inquiries via phone, secure chat, walk\-up, and email, ensuring every interaction reflects Chatham’s commitment to world\-class service.
* Apply advanced conversational and diagnostic techniques to rapidly identify root causes, build end\-user trust, and resolve issues at first contact whenever possible.
* Take full ownership of complex or escalated tickets, coordinating across IT teams to drive issues to complete resolution.
* Proactively identify patterns in inbound inquiries and share insights with management to drive systemic improvements to IT services, operations, and policies.
* Document all end\-user correspondence and technical actions clearly, concisely, and in accordance with established standards.


**Administration \& Systems Ownership**
* Manage end\-to\-end IT administration for the Chennai location, including IT asset management, user provisioning, hardware and software support, vendor coordination, and workplace technology operations.
* Own the administration and ongoing improvement of Chatham’s ITSM solution, including ticket workflows, data integrity, reporting, and knowledge base content.
* Administer end\-user account management, hardware inventory, software procurement, and related systems.
* Conduct regular audits to validate ticket data accuracy and overall ITSM hygiene.
* Deliver timely, accurate, and actionable operational data to IT leadership as needed.


**Mentorship \& Team Development**
* Serve as a primary resource and mentor for IT Operations Analysts, actively advancing their technical knowledge, troubleshooting skills, and professional development.
* Provide guidance on escalation decisions and help analysts build confidence in handling complex support scenarios.
* Contribute to knowledge base development and team training initiatives to continuously raise the team’s capability baseline.


**YOUR IMPACT**
 As an IT Operations Administrator, you are both a practitioner and a force multiplier. Your technical depth enables you to resolve the most complex end\-user issues the team encounters, while your mentorship directly elevates the effectiveness of the analysts around you. Your ownership of the ITSM platform ensures the team operates on a reliable, accurate foundation — and your insights into root\-cause trends help leadership make better decisions for Chatham’s people and systems.
   

  

**Required**
**QUALIFICATIONS \& COMPETENCIES**
* CompTIA A\+ certification or equivalent demonstrated experience in an IT support role
* Proficiency with Microsoft Active Directory and PowerShell scripting
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft 365 / Office suite
* Proven ability to resolve complex technical issues independently, with sound judgment and minimal supervision
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to adapt messaging for technical and non\-technical audiences
* Demonstrated ability to mentor or coach peers in a professional environment
* Ability to perform effectively under pressure, managing competing priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* Strong organizational and time management skills; ability to shift fluidly between concurrent tasks
* Comfortable working on\-site in an open office environment
* Availability to participate in rotating after\-hours on\-call schedule (one week at a time)


**Preferred**
* Experience administering an ITSM platform (e.g., Freshservice, ServiceNow, Jira Service Management)
* Familiarity with networking fundamentals and/or information security concepts
* Experience with enterprise endpoint management tooling
* Track record of process improvement or automation initiatives in a support context


**PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES**
* Genuinely service\-oriented — you care about the people you’re helping, not just closing tickets
* Analytical and pattern\-oriented — you see signal in the noise and act on it
* Accountable and self\-driven — you take ownership without being asked
* Collaborative — you make the people around you better
* Composed — you perform at your best when things get complicated


**About Chatham Financial**
 Chatham Financial is the leading independent capital markets advisor, delivering an integrated blend of expert advice and powerful technology to help you reduce risk and seize opportunity. With decades of capital markets strategy, execution, monitoring, and performance expertise, we serve as an unwavering advocate for your best interests and your innovation partner. Our technology platform unifies data across assets, debt, and derivatives, giving you unmatched agility, transparency, and insight.
   

  

**It’s clear ahead.**
 Our commitment is to carry that light forward in every partnership, every solution, and every market we serve.
   

  

 We help guide the way—giving clients the insight and momentum to move forward with confidence, no matter what lies ahead.

title: Sr Technical Support Engineer
description:
**Description**
 At Gigamon, our purpose is to protect the hybrid networks and data of the largest, most complex organizations on the planet. Certified as a Great Place to Work, we offer a deep observability pipeline that efficiently delivers network\-derived intelligence to cloud, security, and observability tools. This helps our customers to eliminate security blind spots, optimize network traffic, and dramatically reduce tool cost and complexity, enabling them to better secure and manage their hybrid cloud infrastructure. Gigamon has served more than 4,000 customers worldwide, including over 80 percent of Fortune 100 enterprises, 9 of the 10 largest mobile network providers, and hundreds of governments and educational organizations.
   

  

 The Sr. Support Engineer (I.C.) provides advanced technical support to customers using Gigamon solutions. This role troubleshoots complex networking issues across Layer 2 and Layer 3 technologies, manages escalations through resolution, and partners with internal teams to address customer concerns. The engineer also supports RMA coordination, issue documentation, and customer satisfaction analysis. Success in this role requires strong technical depth, effective cross\-functional collaboration, and a customer\-focused approach to problem resolution.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Provide advanced technical support to assigned customers through phone and email support queues.
* Troubleshoot, reproduce, and develop workarounds for complex product and networking issues.
* Apply strong knowledge of Ethernet, TCP/IP, OSPF, Layer 2 and Layer 3 VPNs, multicast protocols, VLANs, trunks, switching, stacking, and service provider technologies.
* Troubleshoot GTP correlation issues and use network test equipment, including Spirent and IXIA.
* Manage hot escalations and drive customer issues through resolution while maintaining clear communication with all involved parties.
* Document and report the status of major issues, operational conditions, customer concerns, and resolution activities.
* Coordinate RMA processes, including equipment delivery to customers and the return of hardware from customer locations to Gigamon.
* Collaborate with Quality Assurance, Sustaining Engineering, and other internal organizations to communicate customer requirements and advocate for timely resolutions.
* Analyze and report on customer satisfaction related to Gigamon products, services, and processes.
* Participate in customer support center activities and contribute to consistent, high\-quality support operations.


**What You’ve Done**
* Earned a bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical field.
* Gained at least four years of technical service or technical support experience in networking.
* Built strong working knowledge across Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking technologies.
* Demonstrated experience troubleshooting customer issues, reproducing problems, and developing effective workarounds.
* Managed technical escalations and coordinated complex issues across multiple internal teams.
* Worked directly with customers to resolve technical issues and improve customer satisfaction.
* Developed strong project management, problem\-solving, and analytical skills.
* Demonstrated the ability to document, analyze, and report on technical issues and customer feedback.


**Who You Are**
* A customer\-focused technical professional who advocates for timely and effective resolutions.
* An empowered self\-starter who works effectively in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
* A clear and confident communicator with strong verbal, written, and presentation skills in English.
* An active listener who builds productive relationships with customers and cross\-functional teams.
* An organized professional who can prioritize responsibilities and meet deadlines.
* A collaborative partner who takes initiative, adapts to changing priorities, and works with limited supervision.


 As an equal opportunity employer, all applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, national origin, age, sexual orientation, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, and/or local law. * VPN connectivity

title: Oracle Cloud GL (General Ledger) — Application Support Consultant
description:
**Position: Oracle Cloud GL (General Ledger) — Application Support Consultant**
 Location: Hyderabad \- Remote
   

 Shift Timing: 3\.00AM \- 12\.00PM PST (US Pacific Time)
   

 Engagement Type: Full Time
   

  

**About the Role:** 
 We are looking for an experienced Oracle Cloud General Ledger (GL) Support Consultant with strong hands\-on functional expertise in Oracle Cloud GL, with proven experience resolving production issues, handling period\-close activities, and providing day\-to\-day operational support in a live Oracle Cloud Financials environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Provide L2/L3 production support for Oracle Cloud General Ledger module, ensuring timely resolution of incidents and service requests within defined SLAs
* Manage and troubleshoot day\-to\-day GL issues: journal posting errors, allocation failures, reconciliation mismatches, ledger balancing issues
* Support month\-end, quarter\-end, and year\-end close activities including journal review, accruals, revaluation, translation, and consolidation
* Monitor and resolve issues in scheduled processes (ESS jobs) related to GL — posting, import, allocations, period close
* Handle intercompany transactions, elimination entries, and cross\-ledger balancing issues
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring issues and recommend permanent fixes/configuration changes
* Coordinate with Oracle Support (SRs/Service Requests) for bug fixes, patches, and quarterly update issues
* Support functional testing of Oracle Cloud quarterly patches/updates and regression testing for GL processes
* Work closely with sub\-ledger (AP, AR, FA \& CM) support teams to resolve cross\-module integration issues impacting GL
* Assist in FBDI\-based data loads, journal uploads, and correction of failed interface/import processes
* Maintain and update support documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base articles
* Handle minor enhancements, CRs (Change Requests), and configuration updates as per business need
* Provide end\-user support, training, and query resolution related to GL processes
* Track tickets via ITSM tools (ServiceNow, JIRA, Remedy, etc.) and report on SLA compliance and ticket trends
* Participate in on\-call/rotational support and be available during period\-close windows (including weekends, if required)


**Required Skills:**
* 6–8 years of experience in Oracle applications, with at least 4–5 years dedicated to Oracle Cloud GL support/operations
* Strong hands\-on experience in a production support environment
* Solid understanding of GL configurations: Chart of Accounts, Ledgers, Calendars, Journal Sources/Categories, Data Access Sets
* Practical experience with allocations, revaluation, translation, and consolidation processes
* Experience handling period\-close cycle issues and providing close\-window support
* Working knowledge of GL integration points with AP, AR, FA, CM, and Expenses
* Hands\-on experience with OTBI, FRS (Financial Reporting Studio), and Smart View for troubleshooting/reporting issues
* Familiarity with FBDI templates and resolving failed import/interface issues
* Experience raising and managing Oracle Service Requests (SRs) via My Oracle Support (MOS)
* Understanding of Oracle Cloud release cycles (quarterly updates) and their impact on GL configurations
* Good knowledge of ITSM/ticketing tools (ServiceNow, JIRA, Remedy)
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize under pressure


**Preferred/Good to Have:**
* Oracle Cloud Financials (GL) certification
* Prior experience in AMS/support engagements (as opposed to only implementation projects)
* Exposure to SLA\-driven support models and ticket\-severity frameworks (P1/P2/P3\)
* Basic understanding of SQL for data validation/debugging (not mandatory)

 We are seeking an expert
 **High Touch Engineer (HTE)** 
 to serve as the critical technical focal point for complex Service Provider network problem resolution. In this role, you will provide deep technical leadership across Cisco’s advanced Service Provider portfolio, driving high\-stakes root\-cause analysis, cross\-functional engineering alignment, and resilient end\-to\-end infrastructure solutions for our enterprise and carrier\-grade clients.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities** 
  

  

* Advanced Troubleshooting \& Resolution:
+ Diagnose and resolve high\-complexity customer issues spanning Cisco ASR routing, NCS routing platforms, IOS XR, MPLS, Segment Routing, Broadband, and Optical transport technologies.
+ Deliver comprehensive, end\-to\-end infrastructure\-level problem resolution across Layer 2/3 network fabrics, overlays, virtualization layers, and compute/storage integrations.

* Root Cause Analysis (RCA) \& Proactive Prevention:
+ Conduct deep\-dive RCAs featuring rigorous root\-cause findings, structured remediation paths, and proactive prevention strategies.
+ Manage software escalation referrals for critical or recurring anomalies across IOS XR, ASR, NCS, and related Service Provider platforms.

* Strategic Collaboration \& Operations:
+ Partner with the High Touch Operations Manager (HTOM) to monitor operational trends, contribute to quarterly technical reviews, analyze performance metrics, and build strategic action plans.
+ Leverage deep contextual knowledge of customer network architecture and change\-control processes to fast\-track critical escalations.
+ Collaborate seamlessly with Account Teams, Cisco TAC, Product Business Units, and HTOM stakeholders to coordinate unified resolution strategies.

* Deployment \& Ecosystem Leadership:
+ Provide remote or onsite support for complex network expansions, migrations, and architecture rollouts; act as Lead Engineer across High Touch Technical Support (HTTS) and TAC frameworks when required.
+ Foster long\-term customer success by building enduring relationships and contributing reusable automation tools, diagnostic scripts, and best\-practice documentation.


**Minimum Qualifications \& Experience**
* Education \& Experience: Bachelor’s degree in a technical field (Computer Science / Electrical Engineering preferred) or equivalent, backed by 5\+ years of specialized networking experience; or a Master’s degree in a technical discipline.
* Communication \& Execution: Exceptional verbal, written, and executive\-level presentation skills, capable of commanding technical authority in front of enterprise stakeholders.
* Autonomy \& Mindset: Highly self\-driven, analytical, and autonomous, with a proven track record of untangling complex technical roadblocks in high\-performance Service Provider networks.
* Agile Problem\-Solving: Ability to evaluate strict operational requirements, architect solutions within defined constraints, and leverage agile methodologies for rapid delivery, testing, and value realization.


**Technical Competencies – Service Provider Focus**
* Platforms \& Hardware: Cisco ASR 9000/1000 Series Routers; Cisco NCS 5400/5500/5600/6000 Platforms.
* Operating Systems \& Protocols: Cisco IOS XR Operating System; MPLS, Segment Routing (SR\-MPLS/SRv6\), EVPN, LDP, Carrier Ethernet, and IP/MPLS Transport.
* Routing \& Switching Core: BGP, ISIS, OSPF, RSVP\-TE, QoS, CGNAT, BNG, Multicast, and IPv6\.
* Architecture \& Troubleshooting: Deep working knowledge of TCP/IP, STP, HSRP, VRRP, and Service Provider core/edge architectures. Expert\-level packet\-level analysis using tools like Wireshark.
* Telemetry \& Tooling: IOS XR troubleshooting, Model\-Driven Telemetry (MDT), and Crosswork/CNC/NCS toolsuites.
* Preferred Credentials: Active CCNP / CCIE Service Provider certification.
* Additional Advantage: Exposure to NMS, advanced monitoring tools, Service Provider security frameworks, infrastructure protection, and zero\-trust architectures.

 DHCP
